articleTitle: Research on equivalent circuit Model of Lithium-ion battery for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For the optimal management of electric vehicle lithium-ion battery, it is of great significance to establish equivalent circuit model to study the charging and discharging behavior of the battery. In this paper, Rint, Thevenin, second order RC and PNGV models are analyzed, and their advantages and disadvantages are compared in the perspectives of model structure, physical meanings and differential equations. The parameters of the model are identified by HPPC experiment, and the simulation system is built by using Simulink. The results show that the four models can describe the dynamic changes of battery charging and discharging process. The PNGV model has higher accuracy and the average terminal voltage error is 0.0052v.

articleTitle: Online Monitoring of a Shaft Turning Process based on Vibration Signals from On-Rotor Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To realize online monitoring of workpieces in the machining processes with universal lathes, this paper presents a novel vibration method based on a new On-Rotor Sensor (ORS) technology. The dynamic responses of a turning process were firstly examined by finite element analysis (FEA) and impact test analysis to gain a basic understanding of the vibration characteristics measured by ORS when the workpiece is under stationary states with both fixed-pinned and fixed-free boundaries. Experimental evaluations were then conducted under different depths of cut (DOC) for workpieces turning under both the pinned and free conditions. It has been shown that vibration responses are predominated by a low-frequency mode around 500 Hz and a high mode around 1200Hz, which corresponds to the first two lateral modes of the workpiece. The root mean squared (RMS) values filtered in these two bands allow turning processes with different DOCs and workpiece diameters to be differentiated. Besides, unstable turnings can also be detected by the standard deviation of RMS. These results show the proposed method is very promising for online real-time assessment of manufacturing quality, paving fundamentals for intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: Design of patrol inspection system for special equipment based on UAV
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel patrol inspection and platform for special equipment based on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). The design of the multi-rotor UAV system is mainly composed of a six-axis UAV platform, inspection sensor modules and a ground station, including functions of obstacle avoidance, high-definition cameras detection, remote control and automatic generation of test reports. These performances can definitely enhance the reliability and stability of the UAV system and benefit the inspection patrol for potential diseases of special equipment. Then mechanical structural check is demonstrated and the patrol application example results show this approach can reduce the danger of detection task and improve the working efficiency compared to manual inspection.

articleTitle: Super Resolution Image Restoration Algorithm : Based on Wavelet and Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of face image restoration, a super resolution image restoration algorithm based on wavelet and bicubic interpolation is proposed. Low-resolution image is decomposed by wavelet transform. Then, the high frequency sub images of the original low-resolution image are interpolated in the wavelet transform domain, and the high-resolution image is obtained by the bicubic interpolation of the low-resolution image. The experimental results show that the image restoration algorithm based on wavelet and bicubic interpolation is better than the traditional interpolation algorithms (nearest neighbor interpolation, bilinear interpolation, bicubic interpolation) in face image restoration.

articleTitle: A simple garbage bin design for garbage classification and recycling
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of country's economy, the output of waste is also increasing. People's living standards are constantly improving, garbage pollution problem is getting worse, which had a great impact on the environment. And Garbage classification and treatment have become the focus of today. China has also introduced measures to classify various types of domestic waste, but most of them is immature. One of the main problems the waste classification faced is lacking of proper garbage collection device which can sorts and recycles garbage reasonably. This article mainly introduces a new type of simple trash can for garbage classification. The type of garbage is limited by setting the garbage discharge port of specified shape and size. By cooperating with simple linkage mechanism and pressure plate. By cooperating with a simple linkage mechanism and pressure plate, the input garbage can be compressed. Compressed storage, without using any power-driven equipment, aims to solve the problem of imperfect infrastructure in the current garbage classification that hinders the garbage sortment process.

articleTitle: In-processing Monitoring of Turning Operations Based on Modulation Signal Bispectrum Analysis of Motor Current Signals
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Online in-process monitoring ensures product quality and manufacturing productivity, providing fundamentals for promoting intelligent manufacturing. Motor current signature analysis (MCSA) allows for non-intrusive and cost-effective information perception and is widely accepted as a powerful tool for in-process monitoring. Signal amplitude-based methods from spectrum analysis provide good detection results but are not effective in diagnosing fine machining which causes small changes induced in motor current signals. This paper presents a Modulation Signal Bispectrum (MSB) based approach to analyzing current signals for accurate in-process monitoring. MSB can reliably utilize both amplitude and phase information and thereby achieve fine machine monitoring. It first presents the MSB analysis background analytically and then investigates the characteristics of modulation phases of motor signals numerically. Subsequently, an experimental verification was carried out based on a turning process of shaft-like workpieces with different cut parameters. It confirms that MSB phases allow for more accurate monitoring of the turning when the cut's depth is 0.5 mm. This is due to that MSB phases are relating to both static and dynamic cut loads. Comparatively, MSB amplitude shows high fluctuations as it correlates with dynamic loads, which can be attenuated significantly by long transmission paths in the turning process.

articleTitle: Design, Control and Testing of Soft Pneumatic Rehabilitation Glove
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This article proposes the design, control and testing of a soft pneumatic rehabilitation glove, which can perform rehabilitation training on fingers and wrists. The rehabilitation glove is mainly composed of ordinary glove, Velcro fixing mechanism, fabric-based double chamber actuator with flex sensor (DCAFs) and single chamber actuator with flex sensor (SCAFs). SCAFs and DCAFs combine traditional pneumatic actuators with flex sensors, which can accurately obtain the bending angle for closed-loop control. Fuzzy PID controller is selected to control the actuators. The host computer software is developed with Python to control the glove conveniently and intuitively. Finally, single actuator bending experiment, passive rehabilitation motion experiment and grasping experiment are presented. The results show that the glove and its control system can perform well in rehabilitation training and grasping actions.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Mechanical Vibration Sensors
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Mechanical vibration is a very common phenomenon in industrial production, and also an important cause of mechanical equipment failure. Monitoring mechanical vibration signal can know the operation status of mechanical equipment, so as to effectively prevent mechanical failure and sudden accidents. Therefore, the acquisition of vibration signal becomes a necessary link in the condition monitoring of mechanical equipment.Mechanical vibration test mainly relies on a variety of vibration sensors, including acceleration sensor and strain sensor. Both of them are widely used and they can accurately collect vibration signals during the operation of mechanical equipment. At present, the research on vibration sensor mainly focuses on the development of materials, the optimization of sensor performance and the introduction of new technology.Vibration sensors are summarized in this paper, which are divided into acceleration sensors and strain sensors. The former includes piezoelectric acceleration sensors and capacitive acceleration sensors, while the latter includes resistance sensors and fiber Bragg grating strain sensors. Finally, the characteristics of self powered vibration sensors, RFID vibration sensors and other new sensors are discussed, and the research status and development trend of vibration sensors are discussed.

articleTitle: Automated Assembly System for Miniature Bolted Joints During the Gimbal Assembly
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Due to the narrow working space and small dimensions of the bolted shafts, the assembly of miniature bolted joint in the gimbal is highly dependent on human experience and skills, and the assembly consistency cannot be guaranteed. In this paper, a precision assembly system for miniature bolted joint of gimbal is developed, which including computer control and human-computer interaction unit, 3-DOF bolted shaft picking unit, 3-DOF frame picking unit, 2-DOF bolted joint tightening unit and 2-DOF fixture and feeding unit, etc. After the prototype of the automated assembly system was built, several sets of miniature gimbals were selected for assembly experiments. The results show that it takes about 25 minutes to assemble one gimbal, and the assembly efficiency is significantly improved compared with manual assembly. The axial displacement of the inner frame is less than 3.0 μm, and the axial displacement of the outer frame is less than 3.0 μm. The designed assembly system can stably and reliably complete the automated assembly task.

articleTitle: Part Coaxiality Detection Based on Polynomial Interpolation Subpixel Edge Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of rapid detection of coaxiality and high precision in the assembly process of aerospace small parts, a subpixel edge detection algorithm based on polynomial interpolation is proposed. First, Gaussian filtering is used to preprocess the image, and then the gray image and the direction template are convolved to obtain the gradient image. Then the gradient image is binarized to obtain the edges of the parts, and finally the edge points are subjected to quadratic polynomial interpolation to obtain the subpixel edges. Improved least squares method is used to fit the circular edges of the parts and calculate the coaxiality. Through the edge extraction experiment of small parts, the accuracy of the coaxiality obtained by this algorithm (PIS) is better than that of algorithm based on canny operator. It is a method that can accurately calculate the coaxiality of small parts.

articleTitle: Fuzzy neural network simulation of vehicle yaw rate control based on PID
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The core of driving force control strategy is the research core of electric vehicle driven by wheel motor. In order to give full play to the advantages of wheel motor drive system, a reasonable control strategy must be designed. In this paper, the stability of the vehicle is determined based on the sideslip angle of the center of mass of the vehicle. Through the speed and steering wheel angle, the actual yaw rate of the vehicle at a certain speed and the theoretical yaw rate at this speed are determined as the control objectives. The PID control is used to distribute the four-wheel brake pressure, generate additional yaw moment to adjust the vehicle attitude; and the traditional PID control is used to control the vehicle attitude. In contrast, fuzzy control using human expert control experience, for the control of nonlinear and complex objects shows the advantages of good robustness and high control performance. Therefore, on the basis of PID, through neural network learning, fuzzy neural network is used to optimize the output fuzzy rules and membership function to control the vehicle. The whole process is carried out with CarSim and Simulink Simulation is carried out to verify the control optimization process.

articleTitle: Gear Checking for the Sun Gear in Planet-Gear Reducer based on Practical Engineering Application
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Planet-Gear reducer with high integration has been widely applied to various fields. Because of smaller size and using frequently, the sun gear is the most vulnerable part of the planetary gear reducer. In this paper, we do some research about a planetary reducer used in a rotating platform. The actual working input torque of the reducer is tested by MPU6050 acceleration sensor and STM32F1 microcontroller. Based on the torque, we analyze the structure of reducer and check the contact strength of tooth surface and bending strength of sun gear in the second-stage of reducer. The checking results show that the strength of the sun gear can meet the design requirements even under the worst working conditions. At last, according to the checking result, the optimization suggestions are put forward for the motor control, which can extend the service life of the reducer without affecting the use requirements.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Analysis of Wind Turbine Working Status Based on LSSVR
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The working status of wind turbine can be obtained and fault warning can be given accurately, if the data information mining is efficient. However the existing SCADA data monitoring methods do not take the history and trend into account. A data information mining method based on LSSVR for wind turbine SCADA data is presented in this paper. First, LSSVR model of wind turbine with output power as output and other 30 parameters as input is built by using the SCADA data of wind turbine normal condition. Then, using the LSSVR model, the residual of output power prediction and actual value is obtained. At last, by analyzing the current information, historical information and trend information mined from the residual, wind turbine working status is concluded and early warning is given if necessary. Through a case of fault, the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method is verified which means the maintenance cost of WT could be reduced by using the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimization of stamping process parameters based on orthogonal test and intelligent algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper attempts to optimize the stamping process parameters to obtain better sheet metal forming quality through orthogonal experiment and intelligent optimization algorithm, which provides a guidance for adjusting stamping process parameters in production. Fristly, the finite element model of the part and the orthogonal test scheme are determined. Secondly, the evaluation index of sheet metal stamping quality were established based on meeting the forming limit diagram. Thirdly, on the basis of the simulation results, the stamping process parameters were optimized by BP neural network and genetic algorithm. Finally, according to the results of parameter optimization, the stamping test of the trunk rear floor was carried out. The test shows that it's feasible that the method of optimizing stamping process parameters based on the orthogonal experiment, which provides a guidance for adjusting stamping process parameters and has value for engineering application.

articleTitle: A method of RCS measurement in the outfield
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The measuring of RCS has great meaning in the modern war environment and anti-stealth technology. This article introduces the process of RCS measuring. In order to get accurate RCS numerical, the calibration of the radar system is the first thing need to do. A standard metal ball with known RCS numerical hung by a balloon has been used as the calibration body in the external experiment, through contrast with the measuring data of the target object, the final radar RCS can be computed. The final experiment data show that the method given can achieve a satisfactory RCS numerical.

articleTitle: Research and design of welding seam tracking control system
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To solve the problem of welding automation, based on ARM+FPGA technology, this paper proposed a welding seam tracking control system design scheme, the whole process includes image acquisition and motion control. The system adopts CMOS image sensor to collect image information of welding seam for denoising, curve fitting, calculation of deviation amount, control motor to adjust the position of the welding torch in real-time, and achieve the purpose of automatic welding. The test results show that the system can perform image processing accurately, locate welding seam and realize automatic welding tracking [1].

articleTitle: Accuracy Evaluation Method of Non-intrusive Load Identification Based on Load Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The accuracy of non-intrusive load identification (NILI) is the core index to measure the ability of load identification. The traditional identification result evaluation method based on statistics has high requirements on detection data and detection environment, so it is difficult to realize the rapid evaluation of load identification equipment. From the perspective of product application and testing requirements, the identification accuracy evaluation method of NILI equipment was studied. Based on the comprehensive analysis of the identification results of load identification equipment, a NILI accuracy calculation method based on load component analysis is designed, and the corresponding load identification test method and system are constructed. Through the test and evaluation analysis of a NILI module, the comprehensive evaluation ability of the evaluation method for the accuracy of identification equipment is verified, which provides a feasible method for performance evaluation and quality analysis of NILI products.

articleTitle: Out-Pipe Climbing Soft Robot with Omnidirectional Actuator
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, design and testing of a novel pneumatic out-pipe climbing soft robot is presented. Made with silicone, the soft robot weighs about 200 g. Based on an omnidirectional bending actuator, a new motion mode is developed which enables the soft robot to climb vertical pipes with diameters between 110 mm and 160 mm. Static tests and dynamic tests are conducted on two different actuators to compare the effects of material properties on the performance of the soft robots. Experiments show that the out-pipe climbing soft robot is able to carry a payload of 500 g on a 110mm-diameter vertical pipe. With a PWM control strategy, the robot can achieve a vertical climbing speed of 8.3 mm/s.

articleTitle: Design of fuzzy PID stepping motor controller based on particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This article takes STM32 as the control core and combines traditional PID control algorithms to propose a closed- loop stepper motor controller design scheme based on logic circuits. On this basis, in order to improve the adaptability of the controller, this paper uses fuzzy PID to complete the PID parameter selftuning, introduces the particle swarm algorithm to optimize the membership function of the fuzzy PID controller, and proposes an improvement strategy for the inertia factor and learning of the classic particle swarm algorithm. Simulation experiments show that this method can obtain a PID controller with faster response speed and shorter adjustment time compared with traditional PID.

articleTitle: Research on Laser Navigation AGV Positioning Technology Based on Dynamic Matching
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of "false matching" or "mismatch" in the positioning process of laser navigation AGV(Automated Guided Vehicle) and the dependence of traditional positioning algorithms on the number of reflectors, a dynamic matching algorithm based on the initial positioning value is first proposed, which can reduce the calculation time and the occurrence of false matches or mismatches, and then an improved positioning algorithm based on Taylor series iteration is proposed. The improved algorithm can realize the accurate positioning of the AGV when the number of matching reflectors is not less than two. Through the collection and analysis of positioning data, the feasibility of the algorithm and the reliability of navigation and positioning are verified.

Author Keywords: improved Taylor series iterative positioning algorithm

articleTitle: Quaternion Invariant Cubature Kalman Filtering for Attitude Estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper presents a novel nonlinear filtering method for attitude estimation of rigid bodies, called the invariant cubature Kalman filter. This method combines the theory of invariant observer and cubature Kalman filter. When using the cubature filter formulas, the proposed method can maintain the invariance of system dynamics and calculate the estimated state with the geometrical correction terms obtained from the invariant output errors. According to the left or right Lie group action adopted in the definition of the state estimation errors, two quaternion invariant filters are developed by utilizing unit quaternions to represent attitudes, named left-invariant cubature Kalman filter and right-invariant cubature Kalman filter, respectively. These general filters are implemented to attitude and gyro bias estimation problems of a low-cost multi-sensors system. Simulation results showed that the right-invariant cubature filter outperforms other comparable filters because it inherits the merits of the right nonlinear invariant observer and the cubature Kalman filter and has less dependence on the estimated trajectory.

articleTitle: Design of High-altitude Curtain Wall Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a robot design scheme that can be used for high-altitude curtain wall cleaning operations. With the help of machine vision and multi-sensor cooperation, it has the ability to cross obstacles of a certain height. By controlling the motor, it can move forward, back and clean on more complex walls.

articleTitle: Garbage Classification and Recognition Based on SqueezeNet
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this study, an intelligent garbage classification and recognition system was deployed on the industry integrated computer with the I3-7100U processor and 2G memory. Considering the unit prediction time and prediction accuracy, SqueezeNet was selected as the classification network training model among ResNet, InceptionV3, and SqueezeNet. The pretraining SqueezeNet network model on the ImageNet-1000 dataset was used for transfer learning, and the model predication accuracy was improved by using image enhancement and Adam optimizer. The comparison between the comprehensive test set and the real garbage image showed that the model predication accuracy reached 87.7% after training, and the prediction time in the industrial integrated machine was less than 2 seconds, which met the needs of practical applications.

articleTitle: Design and development of management and control system for intelligent die forging production line
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Nowadays the forging industry has issues such as serious pollution emissions, low levels of intelligence and automation of enterprises and the complexity and diversity of underlying equipment lead to the weak information interaction between equipment. In order to solve the above problems, the forging production line management system is designed and developed in this paper, the four main function modules of system management, energy management, basic information management, and production scheduling are included in this system. The data transmission network is constructed through PROFIBUS and PROFIINET fieldbus technology to connect various devices in the process. The management system realizes basic information management, energy consumption statistical analysis, scheduling optimization and other functions in the forging production process.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Automatic Cutlery Recognition Method Based on X-ray Security Inspection Image
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the current situation that the judgment and recognition of cutlerys under X-ray security inspection devices still rely on naked eye recognition, this topic will use wavelet transform to extract image edges and realize image segmentation based on the characteristics of X-ray security inspection images. By comparing the imaging effect of the cutlery and the non-cutlery object under X-ray, the characteristic elements of the cutlery shape are defined. According to the cutlery morphological feature extraction method of this subject, the feature element extraction is completed, and the method of combining decision tree and random forest is used for cutlery recognition. In the process of setting up the automatic cutlery recognition system, the data acquisition and transmission system of the X-ray security inspection equipment was designed to improve the resolution of the formed gray image and expand the gray range of the image to improve the accuracy of the image data. Finally, in order to visually display the detection effect of the cutlery recognition verification system, the MFC function library is used to build a display interface to display the original image of the actual detection object and the recognition result. If the cutlery is recognized, an alarm will be given.

articleTitle: Optimization and Control of Wireless Rechargeable Sensor Network Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming to optimize the charging scheme and deployment cost of wireless rechargeable sensor network when the node coordinates are given. We first establish a TSP charging route model of a single mobile charger, use an improved ant colony algorithm to deal with the problem of the nearest charging route, and then establish an aperiodic greedy charging model based on the imbalance of sensor energy consumption of the shortest charging path obtained. Two reasonable charging strategies and a variable step size adaptive algorithm are used to search for the minimum battery capacity required for the sensor to work normally, so as to optimize the entire wireless rechargeable sensor network. The simulation using the data provided by MMCT indicates that the model and algorithm are able to commendably control the normal operation of the sensor network and reduce the operating cost of the entire network.

articleTitle: A Fiber Diameter Measurement Algorithm Based on Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to detect the diameter of wool and cashmere fiber under microscope, an algorithm based on similar triangle theory to measure the distance between two irregular curves is proposed in this paper. After selecting the fiber area to be tested manually, the average, maximum and minimum diameter of the fiber can be obtained by using this algorithm. The method was used to detect the diameter of wool and cashmere fiber under the microscope, and the appropriate fitting parameters were selected by experiment. The algorithm can also be used to measure the diameter of other kinds of textile materials as well as blood vessels in medical images.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Singular Networked Control Systems with Short Time-Varying Delay
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this article, the problem of stability and stabilization for singular networked control systems (SNCSs) with short time-varying delay is investigated. The SNCS is modeled into a time-invariant discrete time system with norm-bounded uncertainty by using the robust control technique and the nominal point method. Based on the linear matrix inequality (LMI) technique and the Lyapunov stability theorem, the existence condition of a state feedback controller is obtained, which makes the SNCS asymptotically stable, and the controller designed method is also suggested. Finally, a numerical example is delivered to verify the feasibility of this article.

articleTitle: Research on Scheduling Optimization of Free-floating Bike Sharing Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to reduce the transportation cost of enterprises, reduce customer waiting time, aiming at the current problem of resource allocation of shared bicycles, a new mathematical model of ant colony algorithm with soft time window is built, which aims at the lowest transportation cost and the shortest customer waiting time. In this paper, a scheduling strategy based on improved ant colony algorithm is proposed, which improves the search accuracy and global search ability by improving state transition rules, local pheromone and global pheromone update rules. Then an example is given to test the improved ant colony algorithm. The results show that, compared with genetic algorithm and traditional ant colony algorithm, this algorithm greatly reduces the cost of enterprise by 10.1% and 7.7%. Specifically, transportation costs and customer waiting can be reduced. It is conducive to the sustainable development of the industry.

articleTitle: Parametric Design of Ball-cage Constant Velocity Joint Based on CATIA Customized Development
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the vehicle manufacturing industry, due to the large number of models, the product features are complex and the demand for parts is diversified, and designers often need to do a lot of repetitive work which seriously affects work efficiency. Using parametric design technology to establish standard parts model library, and through CAA, visual programming technology and CATIA customized development, a three-dimensional parametric design system of ball-cage constant velocity joint is developed. The static calculation and analysis of the automatically generated parts and components are performed by ANSYS, and the automatic parts and components meet the requirements for the use of ball- cage constant velocity joint strength.

articleTitle: Analysis and synthesis of cardioid crank guide-bar mechanism with approximate uniform motion
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The cardioid crank is a planet mechanism which is able to generate cardioid curve, with cardioid crank as the driven crank of the guide-bar mechanism is equal to the mechanism which has a crank of the varying length and varying speed and moving along the cardioid, which changed the kinematic characteristics of the guide-bar. The kinematic analysis method of the cardioid crank guide-bar mechanism is studied, the calculating method for limit position, oscillate angle and time ratio of the guide-bar are given, the synthesis method of the approximate uniform motion mechanism is put forward in accordance with the time ratio or guide-bar oscillate angle, the minimum length of guide-bar is calculated, the influence of center distance on the motion characteristics of the mechanism is discussed. The cardioid crank guide-bar mechanism also has the characteristics of stronger quick return.

articleTitle: Research on optimal scheduling of workshop equipment maintenance based on Quantum genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the production process, production scheduling and equipment maintenance are interactive. But in theoretical research, equipment maintenance and production scheduling are usually separated. In order to consider the influence of production scheduling caused by equipment maintenance, an integrated model of workshop equipment maintenance and workshop scheduling is established in this paper. Based on the description of the workshop scheduling problem and its scheduling method, an improved quantum genetic algorithm (QGA) is proposed and used to solve the scheduling problem. In the improved quantum genetic algorithm, the tabu search algorithm is used to select chromosomes for coding, and the dynamic quantum rotation gate update mechanism is used. The rotation angle is adaptively adjusted, which makes the algorithm better converge to the global optimal solution. The experimental results show that compared with results of the without preventive maintenance, the integrated scheduling time and cost of quantum genetic algorithm are reduced by 15.22% and 27.52%; compared with the results of genetic algorithm, they are reduced by 9.77% and 17.9%. The result of simulation experiment shows that using quantum genetic algorithm to solve the production line scheduling problem is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Blur Image Restoration Algorithm Based on Improved Wiener Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The image is often distorted during the shooting process, for example, the train is blurred due to motion and accompanied by some Gaussian noise, salt and pepper noise, etc. In this paper, an improved Wiener filter algorithm is proposed for the blur phenomenon caused by the camera in the movement process. First, the optimal k value is obtained through the quadratic wiener filter, and then the problem of boundary ringing in the image restoration process is proposed. The continuation sigmoid window and ratio method are used to suppress boundary ringing. Finally, simulations and experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimization of FHB5.10 Electrical Appliance Shell Injection Molding Process Based on Moldflow and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to reduce the warpage deformation of thin-walled injection molded products and improve the prediction ability of their warpage deformation. Aiming at the thin-walled shell of FHB5.10 electrical apparatus with complex internal structure and many forming features such as porous, groove and scoliosis, the four-sided mosaic core-pulling mechanism is used to complete the forming of its side features in the die design. The key point is that the finite element simulation of each scheme in the orthogonal test is carried out by using Moldflow software, and the influence degree of each variable on the warping deformation of plastic parts is in the following order: holding time E > melt temperature A > mold temperature B > injection time C > cooling time F > holding pressure D. Finally, each process scheme of the orthogonal test is used as sample data to train the BP neural network. The results show that using BP neural network to predict the warping deformation of plastic parts has high prediction accuracy, which provides a reference for the production of injection molds.

articleTitle: 3D reconstruction based plant-monitoring and plant-phenotyping platform
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: An automatic monitoring platform for plant breeding is built to provide accurate environmental parameters and phenotypic parameters for agronomic researchers during breeding experiments. Plant weight, soil humidity, air condition and plant 3D model could be recorded automatically. Plant point cloud could be gathered from multi directions by depth camera and be merged by rotation and ICP registration. Revised point clouds of full plants are used as dataset for measurement and classification. With the help of this platform, agronomy researchers could get plant parameters faster than ever.

articleTitle: A Monitoring Method for the State of Yarn Based on Sliding Window and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper aims at the problem of yarn breakage in the spinning affecting workshop safety and production. A general monitoring method for the yarn based on sliding window is proposed. A low-cost monitoring system with AC detection method is designed by taking the spinning traveller as the monitoring object. An improved yarn monitoring algorithm based on sliding window realized the recognition of various abnormal situations of yarn and process. The experiments show the higher accuracy of the proposed yarn monitoring method compared to traditional method, which can effectively realize monitoring of the yarn and ensure the workshop safety and quality of yarn.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Assessment of Vehicle Failsafe
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Traffic accidents caused by operating passenger cars have brought huge losses to society. With the rapid growth of my country's road transport passenger volume, it is essential to improve road safety. The failure of the braking system is one of the important factors leading to traffic accidents in operating passenger cars. This study first summarizes the main types of failures of the passenger car braking system, and then discusses the causes. A risk assessment method of brake system failure factors based on the hierarchy-fuzzy synthesis method is proposed. The classification and risk score calculation of brake system failures of different severity are carried out. Finally, combined with the maintenance records of operating vehicles, a comparison and summary of the occurrence of failures are made. The research results can provide a theoretical basis for the prevention of accidents due to vehicle breakdowns. It is of great significance to improve the level of road safety in our country and ensure the safety of vehicles.

articleTitle: RGBD-Based Real-Time 3D Human Pose Estimation for Fitness Assessment
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper we present an approach to efficiently extract 3D human keypoints using a RGBD camera for static posture assessment and deploy the system in a portable computer without GPU. The approach firstly employs a lightweight model, which is an optimized version of OpenPose, for 2D human pose estimation and fuses the aligned depth data to the 2D keypoins to get 3D localization of human joints. CPU acceleration for inference is accomplished by Intel OpenVINO toolkit during this process. Then two typical postures in fitness called standing and overhead squat are assessed according to the given evaluation standards. Experiments show that this system can fulfill the tasks to extract 3D human postures and create assessment for static actions during fitness at 16 fps. For squat action this system is more robust than traditional depth-based skeleton tracking algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Conveying System for Die Forging Production Line
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As China takes intelligent manufacturing as the main direction of manufacturing development, the domestic manufacturing industry has set off a huge wave of manufacturing intelligent upgrading and transformation, and die forging is the main processing method of large-scale devices, and its intelligent transformation and upgrading is essential of. This article mainly introduces an intelligent conveying system for die forging production line suitable for various types of aviation forgings. Due to the problems of low labor productivity, low material utilization rate, and low processing intelligence in the forging forming process of forgings made of HK hard-to-deform material (titanium alloy), a set of workshop layout and production is specially designed for most enterprises. The production line conveyor system on demand. The design concept of the system is mainly based on the changes in the workpiece shape, size and temperature of the workpiece during the processing. The system can meet various types of aviation forgings and improve production efficiency.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Analysis of Different Flow Directions in natural gas pipeline
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the pipeline transportation process of fluid medium, there are usually small solid particles flowing along with the medium in the pipeline. When the velocity, direction and pressure of the pipe change, the small particles will collide irregularly in the pipeline. With the increase of service time, there will be a series of erosion wear. The DPM erosion prediction model in fluent software is used for numerical simulation analysis. The erosion and wear under different airflow directions are studied, and the areas with more severe erosion and wear are obtained. This shows that there are high requirements on the mechanical properties of the T-junction pipe material in the parts that are prone to erosion and wear during the use of the T-junction pipe. Different erosion rates are obtained under different working conditions. The erosive wear is the largest under the shunt a working condition; the erosive wear is the smallest under the confluence b working condition.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Aided Design Optimization for Micro-chip Reliability Improvement
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Micro-chip reliability keeps attracting the attention of researchers especially to the fine-pitch chip packaging where large stress concentration occurs to cause complex reliability issues. We developed a Finite Element Analysis (FEA) model to perform a parametric study to investigate the impact of multiple design parameters on chip reliability. A machine learning model has been further developed based on the FEA simulation results to make reliability prediction for chip package designs with improved computational efficiency. Multiple machine learning algorithms have been examined to identify the most suitable algorithm for chip package design optimization. Our study found that the chip dimensions have a significant impact on chip reliability and the Artificial Neural Network model is the most suitable for conducting design optimizations.

articleTitle: Research on character correction method based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Traditional industrial production is dominated by labor force, and the quality inspection personnel in production line have a large workload and long working time, which is easy to reduce the detection efficiency and increase the error rate due to visual fatigue. Therefore, it is urgent to use machine vision technology to identify characters instead of manual. However, when the image is obtained from the camera, the character may be inverted, which will lead to the phenomenon that "W" is recognized as "m" in the process of character recognition, which seriously affects the recognition accuracy. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a character correction method based on deep learning. Firstly, Otsu method and global threshold algorithm are used to segment the image. Then, the method of introducing directional gradient histogram (HOG) and support vector machine (SVM) is proposed to classify and correct the character images extracted before. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper has sufficient practicability and robustness, realizes the automatic correction of inverted characters, and can effectively improve the accuracy of character recognition.

articleTitle: Fast recognition algorithm of weld seam image under passive vision
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For common butt welds and poor image quality of weld collection, this paper designed a fast recognition algorithm of weld based on passive vision in the case of strong arc. Multiple recognition threads are managed by calling one image recognition management thread to improve the rate of image recognition. The recognition window is selected to reduce the complexity of the image, and according to the recognition results, the initial position of the recognition window for the next frame is fed back. Through the adaptive threshold segmentation method, the image is threshold segmentation, and then the connected domain analysis is carried out to judge the target image. Compared with the traditional single threshold segmentation method, this method can segment the target image area more accurately. According to the identified target image area refinement recognition window and the iterative recognition process, the more accurate target image is segmented, and then the weld skeleton is refined by the refinement algorithm.

Author Keywords: Identify the iteration of the region

articleTitle: Development and Experiment of Elastic-rope Launcher for Small Fixed-wing UAVs
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Small and medium-sized fixed-wing UAVs have a lower cost compared to large UAVs. Small and medium-sized tactical UAVs have become increasingly prominent, according to the development of intelligence and miniaturization of sensors and weapons, and the new tactics application including teams, swarm, and loyalty wingmen, which is based on artificial intelligence and network communications. Short-range reliable take-off technology is a major problem for small and medium-sized fixed-wing UAVs to achieve all-terrain applications on vehicle-borne and ship-borne. Elastic-rope launcher is available for small and medium sized fixed wing UAVs, with the advantages of brief structure, convenient operation and strong adaptability to environment. This article systematically reviews the development and characteristics of catapult-based UAV take-off technology. The design method of the elastic-rope launcher method is present, including the catapult distance estimation based on the maximum overload constraints and takeoff speed requirement, determination of the initial length of elastic rope according to the launcher geometric configuration and deformation ratio constrains, and the parameters calculation with energy conservation principle. An example UAV launcher is designed and experimental verification is taken. Work in this paper could be in favor of the development of short-range take-off technology for small and medium-sized UAV.

articleTitle: Wear of Sprag Clutch in the Transmission State under Unsteady Fluctuation of Input Speed
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The allowable wear depth of the positive continuous engagement (PCE)-type sprag clutch was constructed using the principle of homogeneous coordinate transformation. The wear depth was divided and the safety degree was evaluated. It was proposed that the variation range was divided into gradients and the relationship model between wear depth and wear time was constructed in the transmission state under unsteady fluctuation of input speed,and a new idea of wear analysis was constructed. The results show that the unsteady fluctuation of the input speed has a significant impact on the wear life of the sprag clutch. Reducing the amplitude of fluctuation can reduce the wear degree effectively.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Distributed Drive Vehicle Reducer Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the compact structure of the wheel side of the distributed drive vehicle, this paper proposed to optimize the volume of the planetary gear reducer of the wheel side drive system as the optimization goal. Under the condition of satisfying performance and planetary gear matching constraints, the improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm was used to optimize the design of the original planetary gear reducer. The fuzzy system was used to adaptively optimize the inertia weight of the PSO algorithm, and two learning factors were changed linearly as the iteration progressed. The volume of the optimized planetary gear reducer was 663589.9 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, which was 33.31% less than the volume before optimization of 994987.5 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. ADAMS software was used to model the optimized planetary gear parameters and performed kinematics and dynamics simulations, the rationality of the planetary gear parameters optimized by the improved PSO algorithm was verified, and the impact load of the gear can be effectively reduced.

articleTitle: A Portable System for ToF Camera based Human Body Detection and Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In recent years, human motion detection and analysis has been a research hotspot in the field of machine vision. It has been widely used in sports fitness, sports rehabilitation, sports analysis and virtual reality. Most of the existing human motion detection systems are based on optical equipment using retroreflective markers, which have many defects such as high deployment cost and complex operation. To this end, this article develops a household fitness motion evaluation system based on ToF camera with a mobile phone. The system firstly uses the ToF camera to collect the 3D human body point cloud information. Then Huawei augmented reality engine is employed to track the human skeleton. As all the spatial coordinates of joints are acquired, virtual human model can be reconstructed remotely on the phone. The mobile phone, working as the edge node between the person and the cloud server, transmits the captured human motion model parameters to the cloud platform. Then a hierarchical co-occurrence neural network recognizes and scores the detected user actions online. The experimental results show that the system proposed in this paper is portable and inexpensive. Real-time capabilities and measurement accuracy can also satisfy the requirements of evaluation for physical movements in sports rehabilitation.

articleTitle: Waiting traffic volume calculation rule of phase for self-organizing control of urban traffic signal
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of real-time traffic signal control under the condition of non-stationary and random changes in urban traffic, this paper proposes a Waiting traffic volume calculation rule for traffic self-organizing control. In view of the openness of urban traffic system, the local intersection and its upstream intersection are selected as the research objects. The phase edge calculation rules of adjacent intersections based on self-organization principle are constructed to meet the real-time control requirements of traffic signals. Using this simple rule and the operation and communication ability of the signal controller, driven by the rules matching with its traffic volume, the decision-making of green duration of local intersection is realized. In this paper, a road network in Qingpu District of Shanghai is selected to load the actual traffic data. The simulation results show that the control scheme can greatly improve the traffic efficiency under the same traffic condition, and reduce the average delay time of vehicles by more than 30%. This scheme is a new attempt of applying self-organization principle and edge computing to traffic signal control.

articleTitle: Study on the Performance of Disturbance Flow Fan with Bionic Sparrow Hawk Blade
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming to optimize further the aerodynamic noise of the low-noise disturbance flow fan, the low-noise sparrow hawk wing with a 40% spanwise cross-section is applied to the blade anti-corrosion reconstruction of the disturbance flow fan. The flow field and aerodynamic noise of the impeller fan reconstructed with bionic airfoil are analyzed by numerical calculation and acoustic analogy FW-H equation and compared with the original blade fan. In order to improve the aerodynamic performance and acoustic performance of the disturbance flow fan. Research findings, The use of a sparrow hawk blade can effectively suppress the vortex noise. Compared with the prototype fan, the air volume is increased by 0.89m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/min, the total pressure efficiency is increased by 7.92%, and the noise is reduced by 2.9dB.

articleTitle: Automatic control system of biomass pyrolysis gas carbon compound furnace based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: biomass energy is a kind of renewable energy. Biomass pyrolysis technology is an effective way to convert biomass energy into combustible gas and biochar. Aiming at the problems of low gas production rate, poor quality, low automation level, difficult to control furnace temperature and high energy consumption in the process of biomass gasification. This paper introduces an automatic control system of biomass pyrolysis gas carbon compound furnace based on PLC. The system uses PLC as the lower computer and MATLAB software as the upper computer. It uses neural network and fuzzy algorithm to process the data in the process of operation, and adjusts the parameters in the lower computer on line. WINCC software is used to monitor the running process and realize human-computer interaction. The automatic control is realized and the utilization rate of biomass energy is greatly improved.

articleTitle: System Nonlinear Analysis for Frequency-Modulated Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a whole analysis about system nonlinear model for frequency-modulated (FM) gyroscope, which gives us a clearly guidance for different noise and how to improve final performance. This model treats the symmetric structure gyroscope as a time-varying system and decomposes the physical system into phase and amplitude modulation paths to predict the frequency noise. Furthermore, the model also reveals the relationships about mechanical displacement noise, mechanical additional loop noise and design specifications, which can serve as a guideline for performance optimization. After that, we can clearly understand the performance indicators required to design the circuit. This work offers some theory instructions to quantitate different physical noise. Besides, this model is also applicative in microelectromechanical system (MEMS) oscillators and MEMS oscillator-based sensors.

articleTitle: Research on Predicting Machining Surface Roughness Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The quality of the machined surface largely affects some physical properties such as wear resistance, corrosion resistance and fatigue resistance of parts, as well as functions such as service life and reliability. Surface quality is one of the requirements of customers for parts processing. The biggest indicator of the surface quality of machining is the size of the roughness. A neural network is used to predict the surface roughness of the machining workpiece, and stainless steel is selected as the workpiece material. Different cutting experiments were carried out at different cutting speeds, different feed rates, and different cutting depths. Aiming at the change of cutting conditions in the cutting process, the neural network model is used to predict the surface roughness during the process. The results of neural network prediction of workpiece surface roughness show that the numerical error predicted by this method is small and the accuracy is high. The prediction model has good prediction accuracy, and its maximum error does not exceed 2%. The model can predict the surface roughness after processing under different combinations of cutting speed, feed and depth of cut parameters, and has important guiding significance for the control of the surface quality of parts.

articleTitle: Design of DLP 3D Printer Control System Based on Arduino
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at a series of problems of ordinary 3D printers, such as low accuracy, high price, and slow printing speed, we have studied the printing principles, printing methods and printing results of 3D printers currently on the market, and independently developed a DLP 3D printer control system based on Arduino. The design structure and working principle of the DLP 3D printer are introduced, and the 3D printer control system is designed according to the automation requirements, including the main function design, hardware system design and software system design. We build the electromechanical integrated development environment of the lower computer on the Arduino Uno board, and write the graphic user interface code of the industrial computer with the help of Qt software. The firmware in the Arduino Uno board communicates with the industrial computer software to realize the functions of remote monitoring, energy correction and parameter setting. The final system can print high-precision parts in a short time, and the price is low, also has good industrial application value.

articleTitle: Pneumatic Actuator Based Tracheal Intubation System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For first-aided surgery, tracheal intubation is an important step to keep patients breathing. In order to solve problems of traditional intubation instrument, such as non-portable, expertise requirement and secondary injury caused by rigid structure, a kind of pneumatic actuator based tracheal intubation system is proposed in this paper. The instrument hardware includes tongue depressor, feeding mechanism and steering mechanism. Pneumatic actuators made of soft material are applied in the instrument. System's software includes pneumatic controller and teleoperation controller. Medical experts can control the intubation system to operate first-aided intubation surgery remotely, helping to reduce mortality of asphyxia patients. The results of simulation and manikin experiments show that the tracheal intubation system meets the requirements of first-aided intubation surgery.

articleTitle: Lightweight design of Ti6A14V small scale spatial structure based on topology optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Small scale topology optimization plays an important role in weight reduction of spatial repeatable units. This paper studies the spatial structure optimization of Ti6A14V small scale cube cells and adopts the topology optimization technology based on the variable density method to carry out the structural weight reduction simulation optimization design of the cube cells. The topology optimization of the initial cube model with weight reduction of 50% was carried out by uniform distribution, local load and concentrated load, and the model was reconstructed by UG combined with topology optimization results. By analyzing the static strength of the reconstructed model under unidirectional and three-directional uniformly distributed loads, the stress and strain results of the three reconstructed models are obtained when the weight reduction ratio is 50%.Through comparative analysis, the spatial cross model is selected as a model structure suitable for multi-directional loading.

articleTitle: Data driven and Running simulation system for intelligent workshop
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the intelligent transformation and upgrading of the production workshop, the intelligent manufacturing workshop will produce a variety of data in the production process. How to deal with and use these data is a difficult problem. This paper puts forward the virtual simulation control technology of intelligent workshop based on digital twinning, introduces the theoretical model and system framework of digital twinning workshop, and then puts forward three key technologies of virtual simulation control of digital twinning workshop. It includes virtual workshop modeling and action simulation technology, workshop real-time data processing and mapping technology and real-time data workshop virtual and real synchronization operation technology. Through the above technologies, the workshop and machining status display and virtual simulation of workshop machining are realized. To this end, the digital twin virtual simulation system of an aerospace production and assembly workshop is implemented, and the effectiveness of the technology is verified.

articleTitle: Disengagement causes analysis of automated driving system
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The failure and disengagement cause analysis of automated driving system is significant for the evaluation of automatic driving ability and system defect mining. California DMV has conducted data collection work on the disengagement of automated driving system in several companies. This paper comprises two parts: the disengagement causes analysis based on automatic driving system technology links and data cleaning, classification and reconstruction of DMV which involves scenarios, causes and enterprise factors. The analysis shows that planning and decision system is the most prone link and street is the most instability scenario. Furthermore, the automated driving capabilities of the enterprises is polarized based on DMV's data, and the results provide reference for the test and design of the automatic driving vehicle.

articleTitle: Structure design of ankle rehabilitation robot
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: According to the motion law and structural characteristics of the ankle joint and the research on the ankle rehabilitation training method, aiming at the problems of the traditional ankle rehabilitation training mode is simple, the treatment effect is not obvious, and the training period is long, a kind of ankle rehabilitation robot structure is proposed. The device mainly uses hydraulic system to make the height difference between the front and back of the foot plate, and adopts the design concept of slide track determination, so that the ankle can reach a reasonable range of motion, and can meet the requirements of ankle rehabilitation treatment. Firstly, the motion law of ankle joint is analyzed, and the structure of ankle rehabilitation robot is designed to meet the basic functions of ankle rehabilitation training requirements, and the feasibility of the design scheme is verified.

articleTitle: Acoustic Emission Intelligent Prediction of Grinding Surface Roughness Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low precision of on-line prediction of grinding surface roughness by back-propagation (BP) neural network, based on the acoustic emission (AE) prediction experiment of surface roughness of nodular cast iron QT700-2, 13 characteristic parameters which fully reflect the characteristics of grinding AE signal are extracted, including the correlation coefficients of four intrinsic mode functions of empirical mode decomposition of grinding AE signal. Genetic algorithm BP neural network GA-BP and particle swarm optimization BP neural network PSO-BP are established to improve the prediction accuracy. At the same time, the larger the entropy weight value, the greater the influence of the AE signal characteristic parameters on the prediction accuracy of the grinding surface roughness BP neural network. After the entropy weight value is obtained and multiplied by the original AE signal characteristic parameters, 13 AE signal characteristic parameters after pretreatment can be obtained to improve the prediction accuracy. Finally, 180 samples from 200 samples of AE prediction experiment of grinding surface roughness were randomly selected as BP neural network training set, and the remaining 20 samples were used as BP neural network test set; the prediction relative error was obtained by repeating the above process for 30 times, and the influence of different order of input data on the prediction accuracy of grinding surface roughness was considered, so as to improve the reliability of the prediction results. The results show that the improved GA-BP neural network has high prediction accuracy and the average relative error of 30 predictions can be controlled within 8.57%.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Improving Properties of 5083 Al-Mg Alloy by Deep Cryogenic Treatment
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The effects on the time of deep cryogenic treatment for mechanical properties and hardness of 5083A1-Mg alloy were studied. The study shew that the tensile strength of 5083A1-Mg alloy increased with the prolong of the time of deep cryogenic treatment within 0~72 h. The time of deep cryogenic treatment was too long, and the strength of the tensile strength of the alloy was no good. Comprehensive analysis of the experimental results revealed that the best time of treatment for deep cryogenic treatment to improve the performance and hardness of the alloy was 12~24 h. The mechanism of increase strength and hardness of alloy was that in the process of deep cryogenic treatment, the matrix structures of the alloy were caused by lattice distortion, dislocation propagation and winding, meanwhile, Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Mg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> phase precipitated dispersively.

articleTitle: An MI-BRB Based Health State Assessment Methodology for Running Gears in High-Speed Trains
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: It is difficult to establish an accurate health assessment model for running gears in high-speed trains. To solve this problem, a mutual information and brief-rule-base (MI-BRB) health assessment method is proposed in the paper, which is applied to running gears in high-speed trains. First of all, the state assessment results of brief-rule-base (BRB) are affected by the correlation of variables. Mutual information (MI) is used to calculate the correlation of variables, and the variables with the least correlation are obtained as the input variable of BRB. Then, the covariance adaptive evolutionary evolution strategy (CMA-ES) is adopted to update the initial expert experience, which helps to improve the accuracy of health state assessment. Finally, through a set of real data of running gears, the experimental results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Review of research on chatter stability in milling of thin-walled parts
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Milling is widely used in the processing of thin- walled parts with weak rigidity. As the chatter during the milling of thin-walled parts will cause processing quality problems, some measures need to be taken to suppress chatter. This paper describes the research overview of chatter stability during milling. According to the physical conditions of flutter formation, flutter can be divided into vibration-type coupled flutter, friction-type flutter, and regenerative flutter. In order to solve the problem of flutter, the flutter is firstly modeled dynamically, and then the flutter model is solved by the frequency domain method, the discrete method, etc., and the stability domain lobe diagram can be drawn. In addition, the research on flutter prediction, flutter stability analysis, flutter monitoring and flutter suppression is summarized and analyzed. The research and methods on the flutter problem are continuously proposed, which effectively promotes the processing efficiency and surface quality of thin- walled parts.

articleTitle: Design of Internet of Things Information Security Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of the Internet of Things (IoT), the future world will be an era of interconnection of all things. The traditional IoT has problems with single points of failure and trust, while the IoT system still has some technical challenges in terms of information security. The features of blockchain, such as decentralization, trustless and privacy protection, provide a new way of idea for solving the problem of information security in the IoT. InterPlanetray File System (IPFS) solves the problem of low storage efficiency and high cost for the application of blockchain. Therefore, this paper discusses and designs an IoT information management platform based on blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Feature-based optimization analysis technology of precision casting machining allowance
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of manual scribing of precision castings with small margins in the complex structure of aviation special-shaped cabins, it is difficult to use manual scribing, low efficiency, and easy to produce waste parts. A method based on point cloud measurement data and feature extraction to quickly constrain registration is proposed. The margin optimization technology. Obtain the measured triangle patch data with a three-dimensional laser scanner, pass low-pass filtering and equidistant dispersion as point cloud data, and then use the local differential information of the point cloud data based on the initial registration of the principal component analysis method to automatically segment it For each surface to be processed, the minimum margin constraint is applied, and the feature-based fast constraint is used for accurate registration. The measurement points that do not meet the margin constraint are added to the registration click by an iterative method until the measurement points on all feature surfaces All meet the requirements. Experimental results show the technical advantages and effectiveness of this method in terms of work efficiency and machining accuracy.

articleTitle: Power System Short Term Load Forecasting Based on Weather Factors
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional load forecasting strategy, this paper considers the comprehensive application of various meteorological factors in load forecasting, and it proposes a power system short term load forecasting method based on the least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) model. Firstly, it provides a theoretical basis for selecting modeling variables by correlation analysis, and deals with the load data to optimize the sample quality by similarity principle. Secondly, it establishes a weather LSSVM load forecasting model, and the model is trained and tested by historical load data of a certain region. Finally, the accuracy and validity of the prediction model are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Nonlinear error analysis of convex surface grinding in RTCP mode
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: When linear interpolation is carried out on the micro straight line segment, the actual motion synthesized by each motion axis of the machine tool will deviate from the programmed trajectory, resulting in the rotation error of the cutter shaft. The reason of error in five axis NC machining of RTCP system is analyzed. The mathematical model of nonlinear error formation process is established. The calculation formula of nonlinear error is simplified. It is pointed out that the nonlinear error is related to the length of the interpolation line segment and the angle between the normal vectors of the convex surface of the workpiece at the tool contact at both ends of the interpolation line. Finally, it is found that the error easily ignored in RTCP mode: the nonlinear error produced by grinding convex workpiece with five axis CNC machine tool is less than the discrete error when the tool path curve is discretized into a straight line.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis and Topology Optimization of Triangular Track’s Load-bearing Wheels
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the existing problems in the design of the triangular track's load-bearing wheels, a finite element analysis and topology optimization method based on the analysis of typical working modes is proposed combined with the design of a 50-type loader's triangular tracks. A finite element analysis model of the load-bearing wheels was established, and the topological optimization of the swing plate was completed on the basis of the force analysis of the load-bearing wheels under typical working conditions. Then the secondary design was carried out in combination with its structural and functional requirements. The results of the finite element analysis prove the effectiveness of the method used.

articleTitle: Mechanical analysis and optimal design of on-board fuel cell system steel frame structure under impact and vibration load
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: When the vehicle is driving, due to factors such as vehicle collision, uneven road and vehicle internal system vibration, the on-board fuel cell system will inevitably be subjected to impact and vibration. Therefore, the impact and vibration performance of the fuel cell system steel frame structure is the key to the safety of the fuel cell stack and other components, and it is necessary to conduct mechanical analysis for the fuel cell system steel frame structure under impact and vibration load. In this paper, the commercial ANSYS software was adopted to conduct impact, modal and random vibration simulation on the steel frame structure model. The preliminary results show that the maximum equivalent stress of the fuel cell system steel frame structure under impact load is less than the yield strength of the material, whereas the maximum equivalent stress under random vibration exceeds the yield strength of the material. Based on this result, steel frame structures are optimized. The optimized structure can successfully meet the strength requirements of the material, which verifies the feasibility of the optimized structure.

Author Keywords: fuel cell system steel frame structure

articleTitle: Research Progress on Vapor Injection Heat Pump System for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
