abstract: Vapor injection is an effective method to improve the performance of heat pump system for electric vehicles at low temperature. This paper gives a detailed overview of the main research on vapor injection technology. Flash tank cycle (FTC) and internal heat exchanger cycle (IHXC) are two typical vapor injection cycles. The two cycles are discussed and compared in detail. At the same time, the influence of injection port and injection pressure on the system is also analyzed, which provides direction for system optimization. Based on the literature research, the possible future research directions are proposed and discussed.

articleTitle: The influence of groove types on air bearing properties
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The surface of bearing is important to air bearing properties which may be damaged by machining process and particles wear. For optimization, the effect of four typical surface types and two arrangements on the pressure distribution and velocity in gas film have been investigated numerically. The load capacity is the objective functions. The numerical simulation results involving computational fluid dynamics (CFD) show that under the tested conditions, the orientation of grooves rather than different surface type has the most effect on load capacity. Moreover, the run-through grooves can decrease load capacity, but not run through grooves can improve load capacity compared with ideal surface.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Mechanisms and Temperature Field for Outer Squirrel-Cage Magnetic Coupler
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For the problems such as the large power inner squirrel-cage magnetic coupler cannot be applied because of the poor heat dissipation capacity, an outer squirrel-cage magnetic coupler (OSMC) has been designed. The squirrel-cage rotor which generates the larger heat is used as the outer rotor, while the permanent magnet rotor which generates the smaller heat is used as the inner rotor; outer rotor and inner rotor are equipped with the cooling fins, and the permanent magnet rotor is installed with the axial fans, which can conduct the heat generated by the permanent magnet rotor to the outer squirrel-cage rotor. The electromagnetic torque model of OSMC is established, and its starting torque, maximum torque, synchronous torque, and rated torque are analyzed and calculated; the finite element simulation model of OSMC is established by the ANSYS, and its operating characteristics and temperature field have been respectively analyzed and calculated. The relationship between the output speed, torque, loss and the coupling length of OSMC and the temperature cloud image of the permanent magnet are obtained; it has been proved that the OSMC has good operating characteristics and heat dissipation capability, which can ensure its long-term safe and stable operation.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Stationarity for NC Machining Process Based on Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of rapid and continuous optimization of NC machining technology in the process of multi-variety and small-batch production, a method inspired by information entropy, which is called stationarity entropy, is proposed to evaluate cutting stationarity. In this paper, we create a process model using OPC UA to achieve real-time acquisition of spindle load and other processing data, in which the spindle load data is used to calculate the stationarity entropy value. The results of several real cutting processing experiments demonstrate the feasibility and the effectiveness of stationarity entropy. On this basis, an evaluation model of NC program block stationarity is established, and the effectiveness of the proposed method in discovering potential process quality problems is verified through machining examples.

articleTitle: Structural Automatic synthesis of planar simple joint kinematic chains
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, for automatic topological structural synthesis of the planar simple joint kinematic chains, an automatic algorithm has been obtained. Fisrtly, with special input parameters of incident matrix of the planar simple joint kinematic chains can be obtained with the help of single color topological graph by the single kinematic chain adding method. An automatic topological structural synthesis algorithm based on the single color topological graph automatic drawing of planar simple joint kinematic chains with specified degree of freedom and number of links can be obtained.

articleTitle: The Control Research Based on Predictive Current Controlled PMSM Drive
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the MMC (modular multilevel converter) driven PMSM (permanent magnet synchronous motor) control system, the predictive current control algorithm has the characteristics of precise current tracking, smaller current distortion, etc., and it is suitable for digital implementation. However, due to the fact that the PMSM system is a nonlinear time-varying system, the strategy usually subjected to disturbances, such as unknown load torque and time-varying parameters. To ensure robustness against these perturbations, this paper analyses the stability of the model-based approach by Z domain analysis method, a novel scheme based on error feedback predictive controller is designed, then the overall closed-loop system is proved to be globally asymptotically stable depending on the design parameters. Simulation and experimental results are present to verify the effectives of the new strategy..

articleTitle: Research on innovative design of industrial ceramics baler
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In recent years, as China's economic development has entered a new normal, the entire ceramic tile industry has shown a turbulent change. Tile companies are faced with not only changes in the market environment, but also changes in production line reform. Through the survey, it is necessary to know that the ceramics baler needs to greatly improve the efficiency. In the design of this article, the machine needs to adjust the stacking brick mechanism and the straightening mechanism, and adjusts the number of cylinders. It also needs to organize the packing mechanism to strive to perfect the baler step by step, and try our best to renovate the ceramics baler. The machine achieves true innovation and theoretical breakthrough.

articleTitle: Constructing an innovative and optimized model for green manufacturing of intelligent electronic products
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to build a complete set of green manufacturing and optimization models for smart electronic products from the four aspects of resources, environment, products and production processes, using questionnaire surveys and quantitative analysis to analyze user needs and formulate product life cycle models , improve the green manufacturing evaluation mechanism of electronic products, and build a series of complete green manufacturing models and index evaluation systems for smart electronic products.

articleTitle: A Novel Robust Time-varying Modal Parameter Estimation Method based on Absolute Deviation for Missile and Rocket
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The problem of time-varying modal parameter estimation for missile and rocket on operation is studied. Based on FS-TARMA model, a novel robust time-varying modal parameter estimation method is proposed in this paper. The proposed method uses absolute deviation to evaluate the fitness of the data, and Fourier functions are used as basis function of time-varying parameters in TARMA model, and by solving the least absolute deviation estimator, the projection of parameter matrix has been estimated. The proposed method is validated by a time-varying numerical system, the identification results demonstrate that: Compared with traditional least square estimation method, the proposed method has superior computation accuracy and identification robustness under outlier’s condition.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis and Experimental Study on Single-Wrap and Double-Wrap Scroll Compressor
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The geometric model and gas force model of single-wrap scroll compressor and double-wrap scroll compressor are established, and the advantages and disadvantages of the two kinds of models in geometric performance and stress are compared and analyzed. The changes of shaft power, displacement, pressure and temperature in the working process of the two models are simulated. The prototype of double-wrap scroll compressor is developed, and the test platform is built for testing. The results show that the performance of the double-wrap scroll compressor is better than that of the single-wrap scroll compressor when the parameters, the scroll plate diameter, base circle radius, tooth height and the area of exhaust hole are the same. The results of simulation and test are close to each other, which verify the correctness of the model and simulation.

articleTitle: Design of U-Shaped Bending Stamping Die for Chain Plate
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Firstly, the stamping process of U-shaped bending of chain plate was analyzed, and the bending force needed for U- shaped bending was calculated, and the punch of appropriate tonnage was determined. Then, according to the chain plate u- shaped bending stamping molding process and its dimension accuracy requirement, the U-bending stamping die was designed, which is mainly composed of concave-convex die, positioning column, discharge device, fixed plate of concave-convex die, floating block and its reset device and so on. In order to reduce the rebound of sheet metal, the unilateral clearance of concave-convex die, the radius of round corner of concave die and the rebound angle of punch were designed properly. Finally, the mold prototype u-bend stamping test was carried out, and the results show that the designed U-shaped stamping die could meet the requirements of the chain plate U-shaped bending stamping process, and the workpiece size could meet the requirements of precision.

articleTitle: A N=3 MEMS Disk Gyroscope Operating in Force to Rebalance Mode with 103 PPM Initial Frequency Splitting
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper reports a MEMS disk gyroscope operating in n=3 mode. The gyroscope is fabricated of single crystal silicon <;100> in SOI (Silicon On Insulator) process. The Q factor of the gyroscope is 57,000. The average frequency split for the drive/sense modes over multiple tested devices is only 2.8 Hz (290 ppm) with a minimum frequency split of 1 Hz (103 ppm). The gyroscope operates in force to rebalance mode with four closed loop controls. A closed self-excited loop with AGC control maintains the amplitude stability of drive mode. The quadrature error caused by stiffness coupling is suppressed by closed loop. In order to expand the bandwidth of gyroscope under the mode matching, the closed-loop detection is realized by force to rebalance loop. Stable mode-matching is achieved using DC voltages below 2 V which can be easily obtained on PCB. The experimental results shows that the gyroscope bias instability is 8.7 °/h and ARW (Angle Random Walk) is 0.351 °/ √h.

articleTitle: Modeling and Numerical Simulations of an Active Vibration Isolation Module by the Power Flow Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Considering both vibrational force and vibrational velocity, the power flow transmission characteristics of an active vibration isolation module are derived from the viewpoint of vibration energy. Then, the expressions of the power flow transmission from the direct disturbance and the foundation disturbance to the load are deduced using the four-pole parameter method. The effects of different isolator parameters and feedback control parameters on the power flow transmission are analyzed and summarized by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A Generic RCM Constraint Algorithm based on Optimization of a Modular RAMIS System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The paper presents a novel modular robotic-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS) system which uses two cooperative 7-DOF manipulators as the surgical robots. To implement virtual remote center of motion (RCM) constraint, optimization-based numeric inverse kinematic (IK) algorithm is also proposed. The algorithm relaxes the traditionally strict RCM point constraint to region constraint, which can provide more flexibility for teleoperation, enlarge the workspace of RAMIS system and avoid joint limits or singularities. By changing the size of constraint region, we can also easily switch between strict and region constraint, which improves the applicability of our RAMIS system. We validate our algorithm and system numerically and visually through simulation, real-world and surgical tasks experiments. It is shown that our algorithm is effective and practical, and our system is capable of complex surgical tasks such as suturing a grape or a pork liver.

articleTitle: The large diameter replaceable flush pipe assembly design and engineering application
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the process of large-diameter rescue drilling using the air reverse circulation drilling process, the through hole in the main shaft of the top drive head of the vehicle-mounted drilling rig and the punching pipe assembly are often blocked. In order to solve the common technology in the construction process The problem is that this article analyzes and locates the cause of the blockage on the basis of a brief introduction to the air reverse circulation drilling process, and then proposes the design of a large diameter replaceable flushing pipe assembly. In the design process, the key breakthrough was made in the four groups of packing and the rotating seal of the flushing tube in the lower packing box of the flushing tube assembly, and a replaceable and vulnerable module was designed at the gooseneck tube, which greatly reduced the use cost. Engineering application results show that the application of the large-diameter replaceable flushing pipe assembly and slag discharge pipeline designed in this paper makes the slag discharge smooth during the air reverse circulation drilling process of the cluster type DTH hammer, the drilling efficiency is improved, and the labor intensity of workers is greatly reduced.

Author Keywords: Large diameter punching tube assembly can be replaced

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Process Parameters on Wall Thickness Variation of H96 Waveguide Tube in Rotary Draw Bending
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on Abaqus/Explicit platform, the 3-D FE model of rotary draw bending(RDB) for H96 waveguide tube has been established in this paper and validated by experiment, then the influence of process parameters on wall thickness variation of H96 waveguide tube in rotary draw bending was investigated. The results show that: wall thinning ratio and thickening ratio will decrease with the increase of the clearance between cores and tube. As the growth of the friction coefficient between pressure die and tube, wall thinning ratio gradually decreases while wall thickening ratio fluctuates ups and downs. As the increase of the friction coefficient between wiper die and tube, wall thickening ratio will reduce, but the wall thinning ratio increases first and then decreases. When the clearance between bending die and tube increases, wall thinning ratio slowly decreases while wall thickening ratio firstly decreases and then increases.

articleTitle: A modified point cloud reconstruction method for complex surfaces
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the field of CAD/CAGD and computer graphics, reconstruction of complex surfaces based on point cloud data is a frequently encountered problem. In this paper, a modified point cloud reconstruction method for complex surfaces is proposed. Firstly, the accurate estimation method of the arc length between data points is established, and the correction factor is introduced based on the centripetal parameterization method. Then, the average of the normal distance between the arc length of the osculating circle and the corresponding chord length is used as the correction tolerance to modify the arc length estimation result of centripetal parameterization. Ultimately, the parametric result of fixed control vertices is optimized considering the conformality and reconstruction error. Compared with the existing methods, the proposed method can effectively improve the reconstruction accuracy of point cloud data for complex surfaces.

articleTitle: Roughness Classification of End Milling Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: At present, the sample comparison method is often used in the industrial field to classify the roughness of end milling, which has some problems such as high requirements to inspectors and subjective inspection results. So this paper proposes a classification method of end milling roughness based on machine vision. Firstly, the image acquisition device combined by a mobile phone camera and a miniature microscope is used to capture surface images of the end milling sample. Secondly, the image dataset is constructed by expanding the image sample size and preprocessing image. Then the classification results of the improved LeNet-5 and AlexNet are compared to determine the more appropriate structure. Finally, particle swarm optimization (PSO) is used to optimize the model. The experimental results prove that the classification accuracy of the improved PSO- AlexNet is higher than the improved LeNet-5 and AlexNet, and can meet the roughness classification requirements. So this method can eliminate the influence of human factors and evaluate the classification results of end milling roughness objectively and accurately.

articleTitle: Effects of Rear Window Angle on Car Aerodynamic Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The research of automobile aerodynamic performance has become the focus and hotspot of automobile industry. Compared with traditional wind tunnel test research, it has the disadvantages of long period of experiment and high cost, which makes numerical simulation play an increasingly important role in automobile aerodynamics research. The geometric model of a car with different rear window inclination angle is established by 3D modeling software, and the vehicle dynamics is analyzed by CFD technology. The pressure distributions and velocity distributions and aerodynamic characteristics of the results were obtained. The results show that the airflow is separated at the rear end, producing different turbulence zones, which changes the pressure difference between the front and rear of the vehicle, and causes the drag and lift of the vehicle to change. When the rear windshield angle is about 45°, the drag coefficient is the largest and the lift coefficient is the smallest. According to the simulation results, a certain theoretical basis is provided for the optimization of the angle design of the rear windshield of a car, which has certain guiding significance for practical applications.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Multi-station Translation Cam Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The mechanical structure and pneumatic device are combined to design a multi-station translation cam manipulator, which can achieve multi-station action and high efficiency. The three-dimensional model was established, and the dynamic automatic analysis of mechanical system software was used to establish the virtual prototype of the model. The dynamic simulation analysis of the main parts of the model was carried out. The kinematic curve of the mechanism and the impact force and torque curve of the cam and roller were obtained. According to the characteristics of the curve, the accuracy of the model was verified. This article provides a new idea for the design and research of cam manipulators.

articleTitle: Research on modular design method for typical insulation fault of power cable
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The training of cable fault location methods lacks effective fault simulation combined with the cable itself. The equivalent insulation resistance of AC power cables with typical insulation faults was calculated and analyzed in this paper. The characteristics and feasibility of different defect simulation methods were compared. Based on engineering practice, a typical cable fault simulation device was designed. Studies have shown that the simulation of cable insulation faults by intrusive defects is not feasible in engineering. A cylindrical structure penetrating the cable insulation layer should be used to simulate the cable fault channel. Changing the resistivity of the faulty channel material can simulate the types of cable insulation faults with different equivalent resistances. The cable conductor or metal sheath is led out through the intervention mechanism and connected to the fault simulation components with different equivalent resistances, which can realize the equivalent of the cable fault outside the cable. The modular design of cable faults provides convenient conditions for cable fault location training.

articleTitle: Structural Optimization Design of Pneumatic Wiping Robot for Small Gun Bore
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The main purpose of cleaning the inner wall of gun barrel is to remove the combustion products stuck on the inner wall after firing. It is inefficient to rely on manual and mechanical wiping, and it is difficult to meet the requirements of modern intelligence. At the present stage, the relevant bore cleaning equipment is mainly for large caliber guns. According to the cleaning requirements of small caliber gun barrel, the detailed structure of reciprocating wiping robot is designed and optimized. The 3D model of wiping robot is established by using simulation software, and the motion simulation and finite element analysis of the important joints of the robot are carried out. The prototype is tested experimentally. The simulation and experimental results show that the designed pneumatic cleaning robot for the bore of small caliber gun barrel is easy to carry, easy to operate, high degree of automation and good wiping effect. It has initially achieved the expected design effect and has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Multi-chip Rotary Cleaning Equipment for Quartz Wafer
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low cleaning efficiency and poor cleaning effect of the current wet cleaning device for wafers, a multi-chip rotary cleaning equipment was designed, which used cleaning manipulator instead of human hands to achieve automatic cleaning. First, the equipment cleaning system and cleaning principle were explained. Then, the mechanical structure of the multi-chip rotary cleaning equipment was specifically designed, and the kinematics equation of the cleaning manipulator was established. Next, the modal analysis of the supporting structure and the dynamic simulation analysis of the manipulator were carried out. The analysis results showed that this cleaning manipulator could meet the requirements of trajectory output and the strength. Finally, the cleaning effect was verified through comparative experiments, and the experimentals result showed that the corrosion depth of the wafer met the process requirements. This wafer cleaning equipment has the advantages of high automation, simple and reliable structure, high cleaning efficiency and good effect, which has reference significance for the research of wafer cleaning equipment.

articleTitle: Research On The Parametric Design Of Hydrautic Station Tank Unit Based On Creo
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The fuel tank unit parametric design platform developed on the Creo platform should combine the existing design knowledge system, reasonably simplify the design process, and realize the rapid assembly of products based on the actual requirements. A set of basic engineering technology operating system method is innovated to reduce cost, improve design quality and design efficiency. Taking fuel tank unit as the research object, the configuration technology of AFX platform and the secondary development technology based on Toolkit are studied, aiming at improving the design efficiency of hydraulic station, further extending the design method to other units, and providing reference methods for other product configuration in the future. Production demand for ADS @ HPU business process system, combined with the feature of hydraulic station tank unit structure mainly the same, there are many series, shape, a similar situation, determine the structure combining the parametric design and automatic assembly solutions, respectively using AFX platform and Toolkit kit configuration tank unit parameterized design platform.

articleTitle: A Study on Rural Water Supply Detection Technology Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Rural water supply projects are multi-faceted, wideranging and long-distances. Traditional automatic monitoring means are difficult to implement due to the predicaments in water supply operation and maintenance, resulting a series of problems including serious losses, high management costs, poor water supply guarantee rate and so on. This paper proposes a detection method based on the full chain coverage Internet of Things monitoring. Firstly, the massive real-time data are collected based on the monitoring system. The moving average algorithm is used for short- and medium-term data pre-processing. Then, triple exponential method is introduced for anomaly detection and warning of large flow leakage. The method proposed in this study has the characteristics of low computational complexity and high efficiency, and has strong anti-interference ability to noise at the same time.

articleTitle: Simulation design of acceleration sensor with multi-stage induction system
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Acceleration sensor can monitor acceleration and trigger switches in a dynamic environment. Based on the coupling mechanism of magneto-mechanical, this paper presents the design of an acceleration sensor. With the characteristics of integrated mechanism of perception and triggering, no power consumption and high robustness, it can be widely used in active and passive vehicle safety, robot and dynamic monitoring system. In order to improve the robustness of system, the closing and holding mechanism of switch is designed. Considering the comprehensive effects of elastic element, suction contact and permanent magnet, the paper built the mathematical model of sensor and the threshold searching algorithm. The simulation results show that the acceleration switch has the characteristic of sensitivity in specific dynamic signal, and it works well in overload and vibration disturbance environment. In conclusion, the paper presents a new design model and method for bilateral multi-stage acceleration sensor.

articleTitle: Design of a High-precision and Multi-degree-of-freedom Automatic Attitude Adjustment System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to improve the joint assembly accuracy of large space deployment mechanisms such as deployment arms, a high-precision and multi-free automatic attitude adjustment system is designed. A measurement system composed of four theodolites and two cube mirrors is used to obtain the spatial pose data of the adjusted joint; Pose adjustment of joint pitch, rotation, yaw, Z vertical lift, Y longitudinal displacement, X lateral displacement through a six-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism; Complete control of the overall system by designing central integrated software; The six-free posture adjustment of the joints is completed through the closed-loop method of coarse adjustment-fine adjustment-judgment-fine adjustment, so that the final deployment accuracy of the deployed arm meets the corresponding requirements.

articleTitle: Study of the influence of force reducing column on the formation of main shield cover based on FEM-DEM coupling
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high quality forming of the main shield cover and the difficulty of forming smaller local features, the SGMF technology was proposed. Based on the finite element software ABAQUS to establish the main shield cover stamping simulation model, simulation and analysis of the SGMF of the main shield using coupled finite element method (FEM) and discrete element method (DEM). The influence of the force reducing column on the forming performance of the main shield cover is investigated. The results show that the main shield cover can be formed by the SGMF, while the force reducing column can reduce the forming force and increase the wall thickness value of the pipe.

articleTitle: Research on Bearing Capacity Parameters of Radial Enveloping Ultrasonic Levitation Bearing
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the principle of piezoelectric driving and ultrasonic near-field levitation technology, this paper designs a piezoelectrically driven ultrasonic levitation bearing, which is mainly composed of a rectangular piezoelectric sheet and a metal cylinder. The piezoelectric sheet drives cylinder wall to squeeze air in bearing gap under the action of high-frequency alternating voltage to form a gas squeezed film. According to the theory of viscous fluid mechanics, squeeze film Reynolds equation is derived. From the equation, it can be seen that cylinder radial deformation and squeeze number are the key parameters that determine the bearing capacity of gas squeeze film. With finite element software, radial deformation displacement function of cylinder is obtained, and the relationship between squeeze number and bearing capacity is analyzed by solving Reynolds equation. Based on above simulation and theoretical analysis, bearing is studied experimentally. The experimental results prove that theoretical calculation method is accurate, which has guiding significance for theoretical research and structural design of ultrasonic levitation bearings.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Screw Failure of Synchronous Rod Bracket
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Subway electric passenger cars have a large capacity, high efficiency, high-frequency door set control switch and other characteristics, so it requires the door safety, reliability, low failure rate. This paper mainly aims at the force analysis calculation and structural optimization of the fault of the screw break of the synchronous rod bracket, so as to avoid the same kind of fracture situation.

articleTitle: Design of automatic filling line system for weight reduction
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: According to the requirement of automation system, the full automatic filling line system of weight reduction type is designed. The system adopts the 1200 PLC controller of Siemens and TP177B 6 inch touch screen, which is divided into 4 station filling machine, rotary cover machine, culling machine and packaging machine. The system realizes the automatic operation of filling, capping, rotating cap, detecting and packing antifreeze. The filling speed ≥2400 barrels per hour (4 L), and the error ≤±4 g (4 L).

articleTitle: Study on Microstructure Evolution of Tube in Hydroforming
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Tube hydroforming is an advanced manufacturing technology for machining hollow components and realizing lightweight structure. In order to understand the hydroforming technology more thoroughly, combined with the research progress at home and abroad, the microstructural evolution of tube in hydroforming was systematically analyzed and summarized. Firstly, the microstructure of the specimens formed under different microcosmic testing methods was analyzed, and the evolution law of microstructure evolution during tube hydroforming was summarized. Then, the characteristics of crack and fracture morphology of the failure specimens were analyzed from the micro level, and the formation mechanism and influencing factors of tube fracture were summarized. Through the analysis and summary of the micro-forming mechanism in the plastic forming process of tube in recent years, useful reference for the development of the tube hydroforming technology will be provide.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Mechanical Property of Aircraft Throttle Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Automatic throttle control system is widely used to assist to control the engine in modern aircraft. The throttle controller is an important component of the automatic throttle control mechanism. In order to meet the mechanical properties of aircraft throttle controller in the bumpy flight, and ensure the strength, stiffness and reliability of the product, the vibration simulation analysis of throttle controller was carried out. After 3D model of the throttle controller, the ANSYS was used to analyze the stress, strain and displacement of the throttle drive controller under impact loading. The modal analysis was carried out in order to find the first six modals and the lowest frequency. Based on modal analysis, the vibration curve was added to carry out the random vibration analysis as well. The displacements on Direction X, Y and Z were observed under the vibration. The simulation results suggest that the design of the throttle controller is reasonable, the structure and the strength meet the requirements of the project.

articleTitle: Clothing Pressure Test System Based on STM Single Chip Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The clothing pressure test system was designed based on the core of STM single chip microcontroller. Installed in a soft mannequin, the system has functions of wireless data transmission, data storage and multi-channel acquisition. The experimental results show that the system has convenient usage and excellent performance. The pressure test can be made on the clothing pressure for different styles of underwear. It can provide sufficient data for scientific fashion design and production.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PID and Sliding Mode Control for Master-Slave Bilateral Teleoperation System with Disturbance Observer
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, a new robust control of bilateral tele-micromanipulation system with different operating characteristics of the master and the slave is proposed. The master force tracking used fuzzy PID control to reduce the overshoot and improve the robustness of the system. This work is also aim to improve the synchronization and tracking effect. The slave accurate position of tracking is ensured by using the sliding mode control. Due to the displacement tracking is affected sensitively by disturbance, we therefore designed a kind of nonlinear disturbance observer to estimate and compensate the disturbance online. In addition, we used the saturation function to replace sign function that leading to weaken of the observer output chattering phenomenon. In order to ensure stability conditions of the system with time delay as well as to select the derived parameters the Liewellyn absolute stability criterion is developed in this study. Tests are carried out based on the multiple degrees of freedom platform for the tele-micromanipulation system. The obtained results show that the proposed methods can ensure the good position tracking and force tracking under the condition of ensuring the system robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Intelligent Design for Fixture Board
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The general design procedure of the fixture board is deeply investigated while the structures of common fixture boards and their associated design elements are analyzed, based on which, the technique of intelligent design for fixture board is researched. Then, the interference detection and associative design method are presented. Finally, verification of algorithms achieved in above researches is implemented. The work provides predominant theoretical, technological and tool support for rapid development of fixture board.

articleTitle: Research on Control Method of Linear-Generator System Used for Free-Piston Energy Converter in Range Extenders
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Free-Piston Energy Converter (FPEC) eliminates the crank connecting rod mechanism to realize variable compression ratio. This characteristic gives FPEC multi-fuel adaptability to achieve clean fuel power generation and higher efficiency. However, the lack of crank connecting rod mechanism makes FPEC susceptible to interference, and it is difficult to achieve stable operation. This paper focuses on the control method of Linear-Generator System (LGS) and the design of LGS controller. The LGS controller is composed of force controller and current controller. In Matlab / Simulink, we established the mathematical models of FPEC, where the LGS controller successfully realized the stable operation of FPEC with the target compression ratio, under the conditions of combustion fluctuations and external interference. And the tolerance of actual compression ratio is within 1%. Therefore, the control method is effective, and we can assume that FPEC as a range extender for hybrid vehicles has promising future adoption.

articleTitle: An Efficient Subset Simulation based on the Active Learning Kriging model for Structural Reliability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Active learning Kriging model-based Monte Carlo simulation (AK-MCS) is a powerful reliability analysis method. However, the AK-MCS is time-consuming due to the large size of sample pool under the analysis of a rare failure event. Therefore, an efficient reliability analysis method combining with the active learning Kriging model and Subset simulation (SS) is proposed in this research. In the proposed strategy, the failure probability is transformed as the product of a series of larger conditional probability of the adaptively selected intermediate failure events. The approximated models of these limit state surfaces are accurately constructed by a novel active learning Kriging model in the proposed method. By the new learning function extracted from the variance of the corresponding conditional failure probability, the accuracy of the corresponding approximated model can efficiently improve. The proposed method can significantly reduce the calculational burden of evaluating the actual complicated performance function compared with AK-MCS. Two examples are employed to demonstrate the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on trajectory optimization of handling robot based on ABB
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, computer-aided design is used to program industrial robots with language programming. Taking ABB IRB1200 robot as the research object, the robot kinematics model is established according to the D-H method, and the robot space model, D-H parameters, and the forward and backward solution of the robot kinematics equation are verified by MATLAB. Then, according to the working requirements of industrial robots, trajectory planning and design of robot execution programs are carried out in Cartesian coordinate system and joint space coordinate system.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of intelligent control system for open flame smokeless Moxibustion instrument
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the shortage of intelligent control in the existing open flame smokeless moxibustion instrument (MAWS), this paper designs and implements its intelligent control system (ICS). Firstly, the existing components and functions of the open flame smokeless moxibustion instrument were analyzed. Then, users' needs and the related information of traditional Chinese medicine's acupoints were investigated as the relevant basic elements and intelligent control's scheme were given. On this basis, the hardware part of intelligent control and the corresponding software implementation is designed. Subsequently, A large amount of engineering practices indicated that the open flame smokeless moxibustion instrument with an intelligent control system can effectively meet the needs of users and provide strong support may be better to delete "and guarantee" for the health of the users.

articleTitle: Development of Computer Aided System for Jet Aerator
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Jet aerator is one of the most commonly used aerators, which is also an essential device in modern aquaculture. However, the design and calculation of jet aerator result in low efficiency. Based on the types and sizes, working principles and functional characteristics of the jet aerator, this paper puts forward the computer aided development of jet aerator and achieves the secondary development of CAD with VBA. Users only need to input the key parameters to get the standard engineering drawing of jet aerator, which greatly improves the drawing efficiency of the designer.

articleTitle: Lightweight Design of an Airborne Radar Mounting Bracket Based on Additive Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Lightweight design of the mounting bracket is very important because it connects the antenna unit of airborne radar with the aircraft bracket. The topology optimization and lattice structure design technology based on additive manufacturing are used to lightweight the mounting bracket. Through finite element simulation, the mechanical characteristics of three kinds of mounting bracket structures are compared and analyzed. The results show that: compared with the empirical design, the weight of the topology optimization structure is reduced by 24.8%, the deformation under the maximum overload condition is the minimum, and the first-order mode is increased by 14.5%; the weight of the lattice material structure is reduced by 21.9%, the deformation under the maximum overload condition is the maximum, and the first-order mode is reduced by 3.5%.

articleTitle: Research on digital welding technology of spacecraft pipeline system
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the actual situation of pipeline production in the current spacecraft development process, this paper proposes a method for rapid calculation and simulation of joint poses in the pipeline system welding process, and designs a fast and accurate simulation of pipe joints A six-dimensional adjustment platform for the actual position and angle of the road assembly. Firstly, the spatial pose of the joint is studied. After that, a six-dimensional kinematic model of the adjustment platform is established, and the homogenous transformation matrix of the end of the platform relative to the base coordinate system is derived, and the relationship between the parameters of each motion axis and the function of the posture matrix is established; Finally, Adams dynamics simulation software was used to simulate and verify the pipe joint pose adjustment process, which proved the feasibility and accuracy of the pipe joint pose calculation algorithm and the space simulation process plan.

articleTitle: Kinematic Analysis for The Novel Parallel Three Fingers
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The novel parallel three fingers are proposed which are composed of a 4-DOF parallel manipulator with composite spherical joints and three fingers. First, the 3D model of the mechanism is constructed by advanced CAD software. Second, the kinematics formulae for the 4-DOF parallel manipulator and finger are derived. The correctness of the kinematic model for the mechanism is verified. Third, the physical prototype of the parallel three fingers are constructed, and grasping experiment was carried out, that provide technical foundations for its application.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and tracing of the edge warping defect of hot rolled strip based on the fault tree method of fusion contribution factor
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Edge warping defect is one of the common surface quality defects of hot-rolled strip. Seriously affect the surface quality and mechanical properties of the product. Aiming at the problems of high incidence, difficult control, complex influencing factors and difficult to determine, this paper proposes a method of tracing the influencing factors of the edge warping defects of hot-rolled strips that incorporates the contribution factor fault tree method. Based on the traditional fault tree method, the contribution factors of SPE and T<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in PCA are introduced. Prioritize fault classification of historical data, and establish a mathematical model of fault tree method integrating contribution factors. The fusion contribution factor fault tree method makes up for the shortcomings of the traditional fault tree method that is overly dependent on the failure rate, and reduces the interference caused by the uneven sample.

Author Keywords: fault tree method of fusion contribution factor

articleTitle: Integrated condition-based maintenance and quality improvement model for deteriorating single-machine manufacturing systems considering condition indicator
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Condition-based maintenance (CBM) can effectively ameliorate the manufacturing system reliability and the quality of product. Condition indicator (CI) is a comprehensive way to reflect the manufacturing system condition by collected sensor data. However, quality improvement combined with CI has been seldom considered in the most existing CBM models, which leads to economic loss. In this paper, an integrated CBM model is proposed. First, the manufacturing system degradation variables that lead to product quality deterioration are identified and a system failure rate model is established. Second, the CI is used to reflect the condition of the manufacturing system and is further compared with the CBM threshold to decide whether to implement maintenance activity. Third, a process model is employed to quantitatively analysis the relationship between degradation variables and product quality and calculate the quality loss cost. The optimal CBM policy is obtained by minimizing the total cost per unit operating time. Finally, a case study is performed to verify the effectiveness of the integrated CBM model.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Generation of Bookbinding parameters for Launch Vehicle Flight Software
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the design process of large launch vehicle, task diversity, complexity and economy are becoming more and more challenging. With the use of the launch vehicle-borne computer, the flight software can realize the variable parameter design of the system, and decoupling between the mission and the software, generalized design can be configured by configuring the design and using parameters, to meet the diversified mission requirements of the spacecraft in the future.

articleTitle: Life Prediction of Outer Oil Pipe of Controllable Pitch Propeller Based on Test and Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, the simplified S-N curve is used to fit the full range S-N curve of the outer oil pipe considering the size factor, fatigue notch factor, surface processing factor and the effect of heat treatment on the life. Based on the linear cumulative damage theory, the fatigue test data are transformed into fatigue damage values, and the transformed fatigue damage values are verified to obey the normal distribution, thus the reliability of the full range S-N curve of the outer oil pipe is obtained. This paper simulates the test scene, establishes the finite element model of the test device, imports the full range S-N curve and other material parameters into the finite element software, loads the corresponding test load, and calculates the fatigue life. The calculation result is close to the average life of the test. Then, without changing the material parameters, the outer oil pipe is taken as the object, the fatigue life of the actual working condition is calculated, and the working life of the pipe is estimated.

articleTitle: Research on the Principle of New Type Sensor Detection Circuit
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The capacitive sensor is a conversion device that uses a capacitor as a sensing element to convert the physical quantity into a variable capacitance. This paper introduces five kinds of detection circuit used capacitive sensor: operational amplification method, pulse width modulation method, transimpedance amplification detection method, charge transfer method and AC bridge capacitance detection method. The basic principle of the detection circuits is introduced. The advantages and disadvantages of different methods are compared in terms of stability, sensitivity and anti-stray capacitance for different applications. This paper provides reference for designing detection circuit by using capacitive sensors.

articleTitle: Optimization of garlic digging shovel parameters based on EDEM and quadratic regression orthogonal rotation combination design
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, the resistance of garlic digging shovel was used as target, the simulation experiment scheme was designed by quadratic regression orthogonal rotation combination, and the parameters of garlic digging shovel were optimized by EDEM simulation. The regression equation for the resistance of garlic digging shovel was established based on the simulation experiment results. According to the regression equation, the primary and secondary influences of the factors on the resistance were shown as below: the width, length and sharp angle of the shovel had a significant influence on the resistance of the garlic digging shovel; the width of the shovel was greater than the length of the shovel; the length of the shovel was greater than the angle of the shovel; and the angle of the shovel is greater than the speed of the shovel.

articleTitle: Community Division of Multi-factor Coupled Complex Network Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Complex electromechanical systems in the process industry consist of numerous mutually coupled monitoring variables, forming a dynamic coupling relation network that reflects the operational state of the system. Aiming at the above problems, a method of community division of multi-factor coupled complex network based on graph neural network is proposed. This method firstly establishes a dynamic directed weighted dynamic network based on the coupled Granger causality measure analysis, and then conducts graph neural network training, and finally obtains the result of coupling network community division. The results show that the method proposed in this paper has more obvious advantages in mining network structure information than traditional methods such as K-means and BGLL, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is also verified by actual enterprise cases.

articleTitle: An exact algorithm for identical parallel machine scheduling under scenarios
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper discusses an uncertain identical parallel machine scheduling problem. Discrete scenario set is used to describe the uncertain processing times in actual production conditions. Objective of this problem is to minimize the mean makespan among all scenarios, which reflects solution optimality in uncertain environment. The concept of mean scenario is defined in this paper and is used to transform the model of mean makespan under scenarios into traditional deterministic identical parallel machine problem. The cutting plane algorithm is used on the basis of the mean scenario to solve the problem. The developed algorithm was applied in extensive test cases, involving different sizes and parameters. The computational results show that this proposed algorithm can solve this parallel machine model in reasonable time and can be applied in practical problems.

articleTitle: Modeling and experimental study of vehicle dynamic characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: An entire dynamic model of a typical heavy truck is developed in order to obtain further investigation. In order to obtain valuable and realistic results, the vehicle performance is analyzed based on road test. The comfort level on seat and vibration isolation performance of the cab is evaluated. Modal test and stiffness test have been carried out to identify the characteristics of the proposed model. An excellent agreement between numerical and experimental results is obtained, thus the current updated numerical model is capable of predicting the dynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: Vibration Analysis of High Pressure Mud Piping Systems and Vibration Reduction Method
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the excess vibration problem in high pressure Mud piping system, an improved piping stress algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the accurate stiffness of the supports structure in dynamic model was carried out using Sacs software. Secondly BOSPulse from Dynaflow has been used to evaluate the pressure pulsations out of the pumps, and then the unbalanced harmonic pulsation forces was implemented into Caesar II analysis to get the stress analysis and fatigue assessment. Finally the inducement of vibration and main vibration source were explored. The test results proved the analysis process and method were feasible.

articleTitle: Optimized design of power supply mounting frame in airborne radar
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to reduce the mechanical vibration of airborne equipment, excellent performance of the mounting frame can ensure normal work security of the equipment. Because the airborne equipment may be subject to worse mechanical vibration, and the weight reduction requirements, the mounting frame need to be designed in light weight and high reliability. Taking an airborne power supply mounting frame as the study object, using shape optimization and size optimization by finite element simulation method, Mount structure optimization is proposed. A more reasonable mounting frame is obtained. The results of the simulation and the experiments showed that the power supply mounting frame is reliable.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting the Tightness of Sliding Plug Doors of Intercity Trains
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The factors affecting the tightness of passenger compartment doors of high-speed trains during operation are analyzed. And some related components are optimized based on sliding plug doors of metros. The method of improving the rubber strip are proposed through the force of the door leaf. ANSYS software is used to simulate the two status of the improved door system under different running conditions, which aims to obtain the maximum deformation and the position of the door leaf, the maximum stress value and the position of the door frame; The result is that the minimum safety factor meets the requirements. The air tightness and strength test are carried out to verify whether the actual product is licensed.

articleTitle: Isomorphism Identification Algorithm of the Planar Multiple Joint Kinematic Chains
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, topological model of the planar geared-linkage kinematic chain is introduced at firstly. Then, node voltage sequence be obtained by corresponding equivalent circuit model; An algorithm to identify isomorphic kinematic is obtained by the solved node voltage sequence. Examples are carried out to show the planar multiple joint kinematic chains identification algorithm by circuit analysis method.

articleTitle: Influence of Supporting Stiffness on Critical Speed of Aero-engine
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the design and adjustment of the critical speed of an aero-engine rotor, a finite element model of the rotor is established by taking a double rotor system of an aero-engine as an example. The first three critical speeds of high and low pressure rotors with different supporting stiffness were calculated by using finite element software. The change trend of critical speed with different supporting stiffness was obtained, and the sensitivity of critical speed of different rotor structures to supporting stiffness was compared. The results show that it is feasible to adjust the critical speed by changing the supporting stiffness.

articleTitle: Using Phased Array Ultrasonic to Detect and Analyze Defect Position of Connecting Rod for Remanufacturing
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the finite element model of the fatigue life of an automobile engine connecting rod, it's found that the fatigue fracture area of the parts is the dangerous area of manufacturing defects. After prefabricating defects in dangerous areas, the phased array ultrasonic flaw detector is used to detect the connecting rod, and the difference between the software positioning defect position and the actual artificial defect position is compared. After proper numerical compensation, the positioning error of straight probe within 30 mm thickness can be controlled within ± 0.20 mm. The experimental results show that the defect location can be quickly and accurately identified by using the beam focusing and deflection characteristics of phased array ultrasonic, which can improve the efficiency of nondestructive testing and ensure the internal quality of remanufactured parts.

articleTitle: Research and Application of a WYSIWYG Structural Process Design Module in CAPP System
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the inadaptability of tree-like structural process design mode in the modern Computer Aided Process Planning (CAPP) system, a WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get) structural process design module is proposed. The architecture of the module includes two sub-modules: process framework designer and process content editor. The active diagrams of two sub-modules are presented. In the end, the application of the WYSIWYG structural process design module is shown.

articleTitle: Design of automatic pipe bender for greenhouse frame
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Plastic greenhouses are now widely used in the cultivation of vegetables, fruits, flowers and other crops and aquaculture in coastal areas. The curve shape of the greenhouse skeleton is one of the most important factors affecting the function of the greenhouse. At present, the equipment for bending greenhouse skeleton pipe in the market basically adopts a mode and working principle, with low automation degree, low control accuracy and instability, unable to truly achieve high efficiency and high consistency of the shape of each molded pipe. The automatic pipe bending machine designed in this paper not only realizes automatic bending processing, but also ensures that the bending forming of steel tube can proceed continuously with variable curvature. In this way, the bending skeleton of steel pipe (round pipe or square pipe) can be bent into a relatively smooth curve at any Angle. The greenhouse made of this skeleton will not only increase the strength of the greenhouse, but also facilitate the lighting. Moreover, there is no need to install the support frame inside the greenhouse, which facilitates the mechanized operation inside the shed, can effectively improve production efficiency, reduce labor intensity, and obtain the maximum economic benefit.

articleTitle: Research on temperature field of dissimilar metals by Tungsten Inert Gas Welding
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to study the temperature field of welded pipe, a finite element model (FEM) for calculating the temperature field of pipe was established with the finite element analysis (FEA) software ANSYS. The Homogeneous body heat source model (HSM) is used as the welding heat input and combined with the birth and death unit technology to simulate the whole process of pipe welding. The calculated results of the numerical simulation of the temperature field fit well with the results of the metallographic diagram measured by the experiment. The results of FEA show that the welded seam is segmented or not has little effect on the temperature field distribution at the end of the pipe. The welded seam at the end of the support have a huge impact on the temperature field distribution of the pipe. It is necessary to wait until the temperature of the overlapped HAZ of the previous and subsequent welded seam is reduced to a reasonable range before performing the subsequent weld.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristics analysis of conjugate cam beating-up mechanism of rapier loom
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: It is of great significance to study the dynamics of conjugate cam beating-up mechanism, which can improve the kinematic accuracy and dynamic performance of the beating-up mechanism of the rapier loom, reduce the vibration of the loom and prolong the service life of the loom. Firstly, the dynamic model of conjugate cam beating-up mechanism is established based on Lagrange equation, and MATLAB and ADAMS software are used to calculate and simulate to verify the reliability and accuracy of the dynamic model. Secondly, the influence of cam spindle speed, component material properties and reed foot centroid position on the dynamic characteristics of the mechanism is studied, and the influence law of beating-up resistance on the driving torque is studied. Finally, through systematic analysis and research, it is concluded that the dynamic characteristics of beating-up mechanism of rapier loom should be improved by reasonably controlling the spindle speed, selecting component materials reasonably, optimizing the position of reed foot centroid, and reasonably selecting matching fabrics, so as to improve loom efficiency and fabric quality.

articleTitle: Research on Markov Method Based on Multi-Parameter Variable Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A multi-variable coupling prediction model can avoid the limitations of single parameter prediction. Markov's theory proposes a multi-parameter variable fusion Markov method, which provides a new modeling idea for the multi-parameter variable array prediction model. In this paper, firstly, the state space set determination method is described, and then the theoretical part of the multi-parameter variable fusion Markov method is deduced. Compared with GM (1,1), the prediction performance is improved by 50%. The proposed method's effectiveness and reliability are verified, which provides an effective and feasible method for multi-array prediction.

articleTitle: Research on cooperative scheduling of berths, quay cranes and container trucks based on multi-population genetic algorithm at container terminals
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Berths, quay cranes and container trucks are three kinds of facilities that determine the operation efficiency of container terminals. This paper aims at the working relationship and characteristics of these three facilities, and carries out systematic optimization. First, by considering the coefficient of berth migration, a cooperative nonlinear mixed integer programming model is built. Then, a two-phase algorithm based on multiple population genetic algorithm is designed to solve the model. Finally, through the specific example analysis and solution, an optimal cooperative scheduling scheme is obtained, which verifies the feasibility of the model in this paper and could save the whole operating time.

articleTitle: Key Performance Indicator for application of Numerical Control Simulation Tools
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As Numerical Control (NC) machine being used widely and increases efficiency dramatically, it is important to improve the quality of NC code. Though NC simulation tools help eliminate defects of tool path and NC code, it still lacks Key Performance Indicator (KPI) to ensure the application quality of these tools in process of NC life-cycle. This paper proposed initial study of KPI in the application of NC simulation tools.

articleTitle: Displacements Transfer in Static Aeroelastic Analysis Using Least-Squares Fitting Method
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A least-squares fitting method combining chordwise linear functions and spanwise consistent compactly supported radial basis functions, is presented for displacements transfer in static aeroelastic analysis, the basis of which lies in the loosely coupled iteration between potential-flow panel model and structural finite element model. Compared with the conventional interpolation method, the proposed method can circumvent the erroneous undulations arising from unsmooth discrete displacements, additionally, the design sensitivities of wing deformations and static aeroelastic loads will be more reasonable.

articleTitle: Path Planning and Damage Analysis of Laser Ablation for Melanin in Skin
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Laser ablation treatment can be used to remove skin melanin. The planar shape of melanin can be divided into circular or rectangular. This paper proposes two laser ablation path planning methods for the two different melanin shapes and analyzes the thermal damage of laser ablation. First, create the ideal 3D models of the melanin in the software COMSOL, which are cylinder and cuboid. Then design circular spiral and elliptic spiral ablation paths for circular and rectangular melanin respectively, and perform ablation simulation along the given path. Finally, post-process the ablation results to analyze the damage of melanin and the false ablation of normal tissues, which can prove that the ablation path planning is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on stochastic Resonation-Hilbert Transform method for fault diagnosis of rolling Bearings
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the initial weak fault characteristic signals of turbines rolling bearing are difficult to be extracted under strong background noise, this paper has proposed a fault feature extraction method based on stochastic resonance and Hilbert Transform. Firstly, modulation and demodulation technology are combined with the classical stochastic resonance detection method to design an optimal matched stochastic resonance detection system suitable for multi-frequency weak periodic signals. The system is used to reduce and enhance the noise of rolling bearing signals. Then the fault signal envelope is extracted by Hilbert transform and the fault characteristic frequency is extracted by spectral analysis. Simulation analysis and experimental data show that this method has good noise reduction ability and can effectively extract the weak fault signal feature. The extracted characteristic frequency is consistent with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Development of Mobile Robot System Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the adaptability problem of traditional logistics robots' grabbing and handling operations in automated production lines, and to realize the rapid identification, positioning, grabbing and handling of target objects, a design method of omnidirectional mobile logistics robot with binocular vision is proposed. The system integrates the application of omnidirectional mobile platform, material grabbing robot, binocular visual recognition and other technologies. The mechanical mechanism principle and kinematics model of the robot are analyzed. Image recognition and target contour extraction are completed by the visual recognition algorithm. The target object is positioned by camera calibration. Finally, a set of physical prototypes was designed and tested. The experimental results show that the system can effectively complete item identification, grabbing and handling.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic-assisted micro-hole machining research and parameter optimization experiment
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Ultrasonic vibration is superimposed during the drilling of micro-holes, and the processing technology of micro- holes has always been a problem in mechanical processing. Through experiments, the data of axial cutting force and surface roughness under ultrasonic-assisted micro-hole machining and ordinary drilling conditions are compared, and the optimal processing parameters are selected. Experiments show that ultrasonic assisted machining can effectively improve the problem of large axial cutting force during machining, reduce tool wear, increase tool life, reduce surface roughness, and obtain the best combination of process parameters.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Anti-collision Device Based on Stiffness Matching
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to reduce the damage caused by vehicle-bridge collision and provide theoretical basis for the design of anti-collision device, this paper establishes vehicle-facility-pier dynamic model, proposes stiffness matching method, analyzes the impact of anti-collision facility stiffness, and establishes simulation models of 38t vehicles, round piers and anti-collision devices by using dynamic simulation software, and studies the protective effects of vehicles hitting bare piers and piers with anti-collision devices at different speeds and angles. The results show that the impact force decreases non-linearly with the increase of the stiffness of anti-collision facilities. After adding anti-collision devices, the positive impact force of vehicles decreases by 52% and the impact time prolongs by 9%. The side impact force is reduced by 91%, and the impact time is prolonged by 59%. Energy-consuming elements in side impact anti-collision facilities not only have compression deformation but also torsion deformation, thus reducing energy exchange during collision, effectively reducing impact damage, and providing basis for the design and application of bridge pier anti-collision device.

articleTitle: Deisgn and Optimization of Dual-Arm Robot for Avionics System Testing
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The paper proposed dual-arm robot for avionics systems testing according to the limited space in cabinet. The robot included two commercial collaborative robots KUKA LBRIIWA7, a robotic torso with one prismatic joint in each side and a control unit. Based on modified D-H method, the paper established kinematic model of the two arms. Meanwhile, the workspace of dual-arm robot was obtained by both geometric method and Monte Carlo method. The common part in two results matched well. Through taking end effector into consideration, several criterions for avionics system testing robot was raised and the parameters of the robot was optimized. By using the Robotics Toolbox in matlab, the inverse kinematics of all goal points was solved as required. The result proved that our proposed dual-arm robot had at least one feasible solution for all the avionics system testing targets, which laid a foundation for later motion planning of robot.

articleTitle: The effects of water content of lubricating oil on wear of friction pair composed of aluminum alloy disk and gray cast iron pin
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to study wear characteristics of the friction pair composed of aluminum alloy disk and gray cast pin under different water content of lubricating oil, the test pieces of friction pair were designed and processed, and the experimental results were carried out on the reciprocating wear test rig. The percentage of water content of lubricating oil is 0.1%, 0.2%, 0.3%, 0.5% and 0.8% respectively. A volume measurement method was used to characterize the total wear of aluminum parts. The study shows that when the test load is relatively small at 50N, the wear of the friction pair is small, and when the water content ratio of lubricating oil is above 0.1%, the change of wear amount is also small. With the increase of load, the wear amount of friction pair increases. When the load is at 100 N and 150 N, the wear amount increases with the increase of water content.

articleTitle: Design and simulation analysis of ultrasonic extrusion transducer
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the wave equation and frequency equation, an analytical model of the ultrasonic vibration squeeze transducer is established, and the structural dimensions of each part of the piezoelectric transducer are calculated. The ANSYS finite element software was used to establish a finite element model on the basis of statics analysis for modal and harmonic response analysis. The traditional analytical method was used to design a 20kHz sandwich piezoelectric transducer for axial vibration. The impedance analyzer is used to measure the transducer, and the impedance-frequency characteristic curve of the transducer is obtained. The results show that the test value is basically the same as the simulation value, and the structural parameters meet the requirements, verifying the rationality of the structure.

articleTitle: Influence of nozzle Structure on Propulsion Performance of Laser Thruster
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The influence of the nozzle structure on the impulse coupling coefficient in the atmospheric mode laser propulsion is studied. The laser power and pulse are numerically simulated using the dynamic grid method of FLUENT software.
