By studying the influence of the parabolic nozzles, straight-tube nozzles and LTCN nozzles on the impulse coupling coefficient, the impulse coupling coefficient obtained by the LTCN nozzle is the largest, which has certain guiding significance for the choice of laser propulsion nozzle.

articleTitle: Research advance on geometric error recognition algorithm for CNC machine tools
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Error recognition, as the basis of error compensation, is very important for improving the forming accuracy of CNC machines. To improve the accuracy of error recognition, this paper provides an overview of the current research algorithms. Firstly, it briefly introduces the importance of geometric error recognition. Secondly, it classifies and summarizes the geometric error recognition algorithm based on five related devices such as ball bars, R-test device, on-machine measurement system, machine vision system, and others. Finally, the research trend of the geometric error recognition algorithm for CNC machine tools has prospected. It is pointed out that the application of machine vision technology on geometric error recognition will be the focus of future research.

articleTitle: Design of Large Travel Displacement Automatic Measuring System Based on Hall Quadrature Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Automatic and accurate displacement measurement is the key and difficult point in large travel positioning of winding system. A novel large travel displacement automatic measuring system based on Hall quadrature sensor is proposed and designed. The proposed system is mainly composed of Hall quadrature gear rotational speed sensor, measuring target gear, Arduino Nano micro-controller unit, PC and so on. It can simultaneously realize automatic measurement of large travel displacement of winding system and online monitoring of rotational speed and linear velocity. The designed automatic displacement measurement mechanism is simple and compact, which has high accuracy, high reliability, strong environment adaptability and better performance price ratio, can be applied to low speed and zero speed motion control system.

Author Keywords: Hall gear rotational speed and direction sensor

articleTitle: One dimensional particle simulation analysis based on SPH method
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: SPH method has been paid more and more attention in recent years because it can give physical properties to different particles and the core equation is vector equation. Base on this characteristic, in order to simplify the model and simulate its one-dimensional form, the cubic B-spline function is selected as the kernel function, and the Lennard Jones boundary force model is added. At the same time, the frog leaping integral method is used to conduct one-dimensional numerical analysis, so as to observe the changes of particle motion state and physical quantity at various times.

articleTitle: Research on Numerical Simulation of Surface Microtexture in EDM
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Surface micro-texture is widely used in anti-wear and drag reduction, mechanical sealing, and improving the lubrication state of the contact surface. However, it is extremely difficult to process micro-texture on the surface of high-hardness and complex-shaped parts using traditional machining methods. This paper uses ANASYS as the platform to simulate the numerical change of the temperature field in the process of EDM micro-texture, and predict and calculate the depth-diameter ratio of the texture to provide a certain theoretical basis for subsequent experimental processing.

articleTitle: The design of automatic pipe cutting and grooving machine based on the solid works
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Grooved clamp connection technology is widely used in water supply and drainage system and fire protection industries. At present, the rolling groove processing method is complicated operation, high labor intensity, low production efficiency and poor processing quality, low production efficiency and poor processing quality. Based on the rolling groove machine, this paper designs a kind of automatic cutting and pressure groove machine which is realized by hydraulic and electric control. The performance of the main components is studied and the design of these components and the spatial layout of the whole machine are completed.

articleTitle: Digital Design Technology and Its Application of Servo Device
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the traditional design mode of the device with high cost, long cycle and poor quality problems, by using the digital design method, some researches on the design, virtual prototype and function analysis, control strategy of key technology for servo device and their applications, are carried out. According to the demand analysis, the preliminary design of servo device is made; application of optimization algorithm to optimize the layout of pitch drive system is made. After optimization, the optimized electric cylinder maximum force decreases 28%; the minimum transmission angle is increased by 30%. A servo device virtual prototype model is built to achieve the goal of displacement, design of the control system. Through the simulation of virtual prototype and the physical prototype servo control test, the correctness of the virtual prototype model and the feasibility of the function are verified. The results show that the scheme of the system optimization technology, virtual prototype technology, modern control methods of complex mechanical system digital design technology, can realize the process of new product design digital, shorten the product development cycle and improve product performance.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Collaborative Manufacturing Mechanism with Full-Processing Parallel Interaction Based on Data-Driven
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of 5G technology and the advent of the fourth industrial revolution, Intelligent Collaborative Manufacturing has become the new tendency of industry upgrading promotion in manufacturing in China. Based on COSMOPlat, an intelligent collaborative manufacturing platform established by Haier, this paper studies an intelligent collaborative manufacturing mechanism with full-processing parallel interaction based on data-driven. With the background of full-processing parallel interaction, the proposed mechanism helps new industrial ecosystem users remote interact and co-design customized manufacturing projects. We also proposed a parallel interaction method that utilize a transparent, efficient data to drive all aspects of production processes, which would help manufacturing enterprises to realize the transformation from selling single products to providing intelligent solutions cooperatively, and supporting the upgrading of traditional manufacturing to intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: Overview of Non-destructive Testing of Composite Materials
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Carbon fiber composites are high-performance composites composed of a variety of materials with different properties. The multiple properties of the materials complement each other in performance and function, giving carbon fiber composites an advantage in overall performance over single materials. This allows it to be used in a variety of applications, such as aerospace, sports equipment, civil engineering, chemical machinery and medicine. In the early production and long-term use of carbon fiber composite materials, various defects such as inclusions, domination, pores, cracks, and debonding are likely to appear. The occurrence of these defects will seriously affect the stability of the material, and at the same time limit the application of carbon fiber composite materials, leading to property losses, personal safety issues and structural quality issues. Non-destructive testing is also called "non-destructive testing". The main feature is that the testing behavior does not damage the physical and chemical properties of the test object and can obtain the required testing data. Non-destructive testing is widely used in modern industry and manufacturing. Based on the research of composite materials, this article detects the gaps and defects that may occur during the manufacturing and use process, and describes some commonly used non-destructive testing methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Operation Improvement of An Automobile Spare Parts Distribution Center by Using FlexSim
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: One of the key problems distribution centers face is the excess makespan and transportation waste incurred during repackaging and storage operations. This paper conducts an operation improvement for a distribution center of automobile spare parts, by collecting and analyzing its operation data, identifying bottlenecks and using FlexSim as a "what if" tool for event simulation experimentation and workload balancing. The simulation results are normalized and an improved solution for both makespan and transportation reduction is determined.

articleTitle: Mechanical Stability Analysis of Running Deepwater Tree
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the theory of material mechanics and environmental forces, an analytical model for running subsea tree is established. The model comprehensively considers ocean current speed, operating water depth, seawater resistance coefficient and subsea tree weight. The analyses show that wave load has great effect on bending moment of the drill string head, but has little influence on lateral displacement, thus it can produce bigger error without consideration of wave load. Drilling ship shift has certain effect on lateral displacement of running subsea tree, but has little influence on angular distortion, shear force , and bending moment of the subsea tree. Mechanical stability of running subsea tree is influenced by sea water's resistance coefficient, sea surface current's velocity and operation water's depth.

articleTitle: On-line Detection of Valve Gas Leakage by Sensing Untrasonic Impedance
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this work, the motion and deformation of single bubbles rising in quiescent ionic liquid of [bmim]PF6 and water were investigated by injecting bubbles into these two liquids through orifices with different inner diameters. Bubble size, aspect ratio and velocity were measured by processing images taken by high-speed camera, operated at 1000 frames per second with a resolution of 1280_512 pixels.

articleTitle: Stiffness Analysis of The 4-DOF Parallel Manipulator with Compound Spherical Joints
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A novel 4-DOF parallel manipulator with compound spherical joints is introduced. Its characteristics are analyzed according to the structure of the mechanism. In order to measure the influence of constraint force on the stiffness of the parallel manipulator. The 4-DOF parallel manipulators with compound spherical joints is equivalent to 6-DOF parallel manipulators. The kinematic model of the equivalent PM is built by vector method. Then the Stiffness model of the 4-DOF parallel manipulators is constructed. A finite element model of this parallel manipulators is constructed and the simulation solutions are obtained. The correctness of the stiffness model is verified, which provide the theoretical and technical foundations for its application.

articleTitle: Research on the Integration of CAD/CAM Technology and Design Aesthetics of Modern Mechanical Products
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To study the integration and key technology of modern mechanical product CAD/CAM technology and design aesthetics. Based on the research and analysis of CAD/CAM technology content and design aesthetics in the whole life cycle of product market demand analysis, design, process planning, production, sales and scrap, this paper studies the content integration of product CAD/CAM technology and design aesthetics, and discusses the key technologies of integration. It is concluded that design aesthetics runs through the whole process of the life cycle of modern products, and can be perfectly integrated with CAD/CAM technology in content. In the process of integration, in addition to the CAD/CAM technology itself, the cultivation of comprehensive aesthetics and professional qualities of personnel is also very important. In order to improve the market competitiveness of products, it is of great significance to apply design aesthetics to the process of product design and production, so as to produce products with functional beauty, price beauty and appearance beauty.

articleTitle: Identifying Key Parts of Complex Mechanical Products Based on Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The identification of key parts is of great significance in the whole life cycle of complex mechanical products. In this paper, a new method to measure the importance of parts is proposed. Firstly, a weighted parts association network (WPAN) is developed, taking into consideration assembly relationships and significant measurement relationships. Secondly, strength centrality and closeness centrality are integrated based on Dempster-Shafer evidence theory to identify key parts in WPAN. Then the susceptible-infected-susceptible (SIS) model is used for the evaluation of the method. Finally, an industrial case is used to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Summarize of the Linear Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In recent years, with the improvement of linear motor technology, linear motor has been widely used in industry, civil, military and other linear motion occasions. This paper mainly discusses the working principle, classification, characteristics, system matching and selection, application and development prospect of linear motor.

articleTitle: Design optimization and simulation analysis of grab sampling head
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A grab sampler is designed for asteroid sampling. The sampler is composed of sampling head, sampling turntable, transposition module and cavity module. MATLAB and Adams were used to optimize the sampling head mechanism and kinematics simulation analysis. The optimized sampling head cavity door closing time is short and the trigger force is small.

articleTitle: Research on the automatic measurement of the clearance width of flameproof electrical apparatus
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of flameproof electrical apparatus gap measurement demand in the current coal mine and other flammable and combustible environment, this paper proposed a new automatic measurement method for mine flameproof clearance measuring, which is fast and easy to operate and satisfy the demand of gap measurement of bulk flameproof equipment under mine. Based on the image processing method, the measuring instrument uses the microscope camera to collect the image, and the gap width is obtained by analyzing and processing the gap in the image. The measurement is fast, real-time and portable, which can significantly improve the efficiency of the current underground safety inspection.

articleTitle: Research on Stability of lnverter with Fuzzy Digital Locked Loop
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The implementation of three-phase grid-connected inverter provides a feasible solution for energy problems. In this paper, the impedance analysis is adopted to analyze the inverter and the power grid respectively. The Synchronous Reference Frame phase-locked Loop (SRF-PLL) parameters are implemented, and the d-q axis directional models using the fuzzy parameter Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) are deduced. The effects of strong electricity, weak current and DC input on the output of three-phase system are compared, and whether fuzzy control can optimize the output results is discussed, finally, the relationship between input frequency, input voltage, and output current is simulated. The results of simulation show that fuzzy control can improve the stability of the inverter and make the system more stable under certain conditions.

articleTitle: B-rep based automatic incremental blend suppression for meshing
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The feature suppression from B-rep models is significant for saving finite element (FE) mesh generation time and improving mesh quality. This paper presented a B-rep based automatic incremental blend suppression algorithm, which is the pre-processing for efficient and qualified mesh generation. By using the Face-Edge (F-E) graph, a four-step incremental suppression procedure was carried out to suppress the blend features arising in diversity structures. Examples are given to demonstrate the validity and applicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modelling Surface Topography in Ultra-Precision Grinding Process
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Ultra-precision grinding is an often used manufacturing technology to achieve high surface quality of monocrystal silicon to satisfy severe requirements. However, the final ground surface is sensitive to the grinding conditions, such as the wheel type, processing parameters and the vibration, etc., which is not easy to systematacially research by experimental method. Since the material removal process is a comprehensive result of the interaction between grains and the workpiece surface, an analytical simulation method based on the grains trajectories of wheel is more efficient. Particularly, in ultra-precision grinding, the grains can achieve ductile removal mode under certain processing conditions, which means the final surface topography is much closer to the result of the simply interaction of grains trajectories. Thus, this work aims to develop a suitable numerical simulation method to generate ultra-precise surface topography. First, simulate the topological matrix model of the grinding wheel shape, and then generate the grain trajectory based on the movement relationship between the grinding wheel and the workpiece. Finally, the simulation results are compared with the experimental results from the surface topography, which proves the effectiveness of the analytical simulation method. This method in this work can be used to derive the best parameters for process conditions..

articleTitle: Design of Minimal Quantity Lubrication System with Improved PID Control
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To overcome the shortcomings of low automation, low test precision, and inaccurate control precision in the micro-lubrication device, a minimal quantity lubrication (MQL) system with high accuracy was designed. The system is composed of sensors (e.g. flow sensor, air pressure sensor), microcontroller unit (MCU), and control mechanism (e.g. peristaltic pump, air pressure valve), which can realize the functions of automatic detection, signal processing, and control in real-time. Concurrently, the improved PID control algorithm (GA_PID) based on genetic algorithm (GA) to optimize PID parameters makes the whole control system to achieve rapid response and accurate control. In this study, the MQL system with an improved PID control algorithm has high stability and has engineering application value due to its high efficiency of regulating parameter performance.

articleTitle: Research on a novel RCM mechanism of surgical robot
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to improve the operation accuracy and operation space of the robot, a new three DOF RCM mechanism is proposed. Based on the study of the advantages and disadvantages of the classical RCM mechanisms, a single parallelogram-single synchronous belt RCM mechanism with high positioning accuracy and good motion stability is designed. The D-H parameter method is used to establish the kinematic equation of the RCM mechanism, and the Monte Carlo method is used to solve the kinematic space of the mechanism, which presents an "Inverted Cone" shape. In order to improve the reverse drivability of the RCM mechanism, a kind of Spring-rope wheel gravity compensation method is proposed, and the compensation effect is verified to be 80% by Adams. A virtual operation simulation model is built in ADAMS to verify the high positioning accuracy and strong motion stability of the new RCM mechanism, and a solution method for the positioning accuracy and motion delay of the mechanism is proposed.

articleTitle: Cutting constitutive model of metallic glass based on stress-temperature sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Metallic glass is a kind of material with high stress- temperature double sensitivity and it's difficult to describe its material properties with traditional constitutive model. As a result of the lacking of suitable flow stress constitutive model in FEM software for cutting simulation of metallic glass, a flow stress constitutive model of metallic glass(Vit1) considering the effect of hydrostatic stress and temperature subsection is presented based on the stress-temperature sensitivity of metallic glass. Basic model parameters were defined through mechanic test data and temperature influence coefficient was emphatically optimized by orthogonal cutting experiment inverse analysis methods. By establishing metallic glass FEM cutting simulation model, cutting force and cutting chip morphology was obtained, which agree well with experiment result.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Lubrication Film in Piston Ring of Fuel Dispenser Flowmeter Based on Hydrodynamic Lubrication
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Hydrodynamic lubrication is an ideal state of lubrication in that friction and wear hardly occur. The friction pair of piston ring-cylinder liner is one of the most important friction pairs in a flowmeter. With the development of flowmeter aiming at high-precision and high-stability, how to make the piston ring-cylinder liner system maintain a good lubrication condition has great importance in terms of reducing the friction and wear. In this paper, a hydrodynamic lubrication mathematical model on the surface of piston ring was established. And the finite difference method(FDM) and successive over relaxation method(SOR) were adopted to solve the mathematical model numerically. The dimensionless average pressure of the lubrication film was taken as the criterion to estimate the hydrodynamic lubrication performance of the piston ring, and the effects of different flow rate conditions, different fluid viscosities and different minimum film thicknesses on the lubrication film pressure distribution were investigated respectively. The numerical analysis results reveal that: (a) the average pressure decreases with the increase of minimum film thickness, under the condition of the same minimum film thickness, when the medium is diesel, the average pressure is greater than the average pressure when the medium is gasoline; (b) the lubrication film pressure increases with the increase of flow rate, and the flow regime of the lubrication film changes with the change of flow rate; (c) as the viscosity increases, the pressure increases as well, for the same leakage clearance, the higher the viscosity, the larger load-carrying capacity of the clearance lubrication film. These results provide a guidance for lubrication design of piston ring-cylinder liner friction pair.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Model of Diamond Disc Sawing Machine with Variable Material Removal Rate
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Energy consumption model is the basis of stone sawing energy consumption optimization. The reliable evidence can be provided by precise model for stone sawing process. The most efficient stone sawing processing scheme can be selected. Based on processing parameters, improved power and energy model was established. Sawing parameters was taken as the basic variate, of which the influence on improved power and energy model was adequately considered. The processing power characteristics were demonstrated. Based on the average material removal rate, the other energy consumption model was set up. The processing power and energy was convenient to be calculated based on the average material removal rate. The power and energy consumption model of variable material removal rate and constant material removal rate process was built. The whole energy consumption was determined. By the way of data collection, statistical analysis and curve fitting, the two models' coefficients were obtained. An example of sawing Lotus red granite block in a Rizhao stone processing enterprise was used to verify the feasibility of the two energy consumption models.

articleTitle: Research on Normative Inspection Method of Geometric Tolerance Marking for MBD Model
publicationTitle: 2020 3rd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the challenges of manual normative inspections caused by the wide variety of geometric tolerance annotations and complex relationships in the MBD model, the research on normative inspection method of geometric tolerance marking for MBD model is carried out. The non-standard geometric tolerance annotations are divided into four types which include contradict annotation, redundant annotation, missing annotation and uncertain annotation. What's more, a nine-tuple model for normative inspection is established. For the four types of non-standard annotations, an inspection model and a rule system for geometric tolerance have been constructed. On the basis of theoretical research, the "normative inspection system of geometric tolerance annotations marking for MBD model" is designed and developed with Creo's secondary development technology. At last, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified through engineering example tests.
